title: Sutra-khanda, part 8 (portion 08)
html:
Narada glorifies Gaura, who sends him to Balarama in Shvetadvipa; the Lord reveals to His associates why He will be born on earth; Narada with Balarama, who on hearing the command bids His own to take birth on earth; the descent of the associates — Advaita, Nityananda, Sita and many others; praise of Narahari Sarakara, Raghunandana and Mukunda Dasa; the author's humility; the end of the Sutra-khanda

মুনি বোলে মহাপ্রভু, হেন অপরূপ কভু,
না দেখিল না শুনিল আমি ।
জনম সফল আজি, দেখিল অমিয়া-রাজি,
ধনি ধনি আপনাকে মানি ॥ ৫৩১ ॥

muni bole mahāprabhu, hena aparūpa kabhu,
nā dekhila nā śunila āmi |
janama saphala āji, dekhila amiẏā-rāji,
dhani dhani āpanāke māni || 531 ||

muni bole mahaprabhu — the sage says: Mahaprabhu; hena aparupa kabhu — such a wonder ever; na dekhila na shunila ami — I have not seen nor heard; janama saphala aji — today my life bore fruit; dekhila amiya-raji — I have seen a treasury of nectar; dhani dhani apanake mani — I count myself blessed

531The sage says: "Mahaprabhu, such a wonder I have never
seen nor heard of.
Today my life has borne fruit — I have seen a treasury of nectar,
and I count myself blessed, blessed.

ব্রহ্মাদি না জানে তত্ত্ব, অবতার অবিদিত,
অচিন্ত্য বলিয়া বলি তোমা ।
জ্যোতির্ময় বোলে কেহো, মুখে না নির্বচে সেহো,
কহিবারে নাহিক উপমা ॥ ৫৩২ ॥

brahmādi nā jāne tattba, abatāra abidita,
acintya baliẏā bali tomā |
jyotirmaẏa bole keho, mukhe nā nirbace seho,
kahibāre nāhika upamā || 532 ||

brahmadi na jane tattva — Brahma and the rest do not know the truth; avatara avidita — the descent is unknown; achintya baliya bali toma — I call You inconceivable; jyotirmaya bole keho — some call [You] effulgence; mukhe na nirvache seho — even they cannot express in words; kahibare nahika upama — there is no comparison to tell

532Brahma and the others do not know the truth; Your coming is unknown [to them];
I call You inconceivable.
Some call [You] effulgence — but even they cannot express [You] in words:
there is no comparison to tell it.

কেহ বলে পরাৎপর, প্রধান পুরুষবর,
বিচারে না করে নিরূপণ ।
সর্বময় তোর শক্তি, দেখিয়া না পায় মুক্তি,
অগোচর তোর আচরণ ॥ ৫৩৩ ॥

keha bale parātpara, pradhāna puruṣabara,
bicāre nā kare nirūpaṇa |
sarbamaẏa tora śakti, dekhiẏā nā pāẏa mukti,
agocara tora ācaraṇa || 533 ||

keha bale paratpara — some say: higher than the highest; pradhana purusha-vara — the chief, best Purusha; vichare na kare nirupana — by reasoning do not determine; sarvamaya tora shakti — Your shakti is in all; dekhiya na paya mukti — seeing, they do not attain liberation; agochara tora acharana — Your deeds are beyond reach

533Some say, 'Higher than the highest, the chief, the best Purusha' —
but by reasoning they cannot determine [You].
Seeing that Your shakti is in all, they do not attain liberation;
Your deeds are beyond reach.

সহস্রফণা অনন্ত, না পাঞা গুণের অন্ত,
দ্বিজিহ্বা ধরিল সব মুখে ।
না পাঞা গুণের ওর, এছন ঠাকুর গৌর,
কপালে দেখিলাম তোকে ॥ ৫৩৪ ॥

sahasraphaṇā ananta, nā pāñā guṇera anta,
dbijihbā dharila saba mukhe |
nā pāñā guṇera ora, echana ṭhākura gaura,
kapāle dekhilāma toke || 534 ||

sahasra-phana ananta — thousand-hooded Ananta; na pana gunera anta — not finding the end of virtues; dvijihva dharila saba mukhe — took two tongues in every mouth; na pana gunera ora — not finding the limit of virtues; aichhana thakura gaura — such a Lord, Gaura; kapale dekhilama toke — by fortune I have seen You

534Thousand-headed Ananta, finding no end to [Your] virtues,
has taken two tongues in every mouth;
finding no limit to Your virtues — such a Lord are You, Gaura —
by good fortune I have seen You!

যে পুনঃ আরতি করে, তুয়া-পদ অনুসারে,
নানাবুদ্ধি নহে একমত ।
কেহ বলে সর্বব্যাপী, সূক্ষ্মবাদী সাংখ্যযোগী,
স্থূলসেবা করয়ে ভকত ॥ ৫৩৫ ॥

ye punaḥ ārati kare, tuẏā-pada anusāre,
nānābuddhi nahe ekamata |
keha bale sarbabyāpī, sūkṣmabādī sāṃkhyayogī,
sthūlasebā karaẏe bhakata || 535 ||

ye punah arati kare — those who long; tuya-pada anusare — following Your feet; nana-buddhi nahe ekamata — of various understanding, not of one mind; keha bale sarvavyapi — some say: all-pervading; sukshmavadi sankhya-yogi — Sankhya-yogis who speak of the subtle; sthula-seva karaye bhakata — devotees serve the visible form

535And those who long [for You], following Your feet,
are of various understanding, not of one opinion:
some say, 'The All-pervading' — these are the Sankhya-yogis who speak of the subtle;
the devotees serve [Your] visible form.

কেহ বেদ-অনুসারে, নিত্য ধর্ম কর্ম করে,
বর্ণাশ্রম-ধর্ম-অনুগত ।
বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত যেই, সমাধান নাহি পাই,
না বুঝিয়া কহে নানা মত ॥ ৫৩৬ ॥

keha beda-anusāre, nitya dharma karma kare,
barṇāśrama-dharma-anugata |
bedānta-siddhānta yei, samādhāna nāhi pāi,
nā bujhiẏā kahe nānā mata || 536 ||

keha veda-anusare — some, following the Vedas; nitya dharma karma kare — perform the eternal dharma and rites; varnashrama-dharma-anugata — adhering to the dharma of varna and ashrama; vedanta-siddhanta yei — the conclusion of Vedanta; samadhana nahi pai — I do not find; na bujhiya kahe nana mata — not understanding, they say many things

536Others, following the Vedas, perform the eternal dharma and rites,
adhering to the dharma of varna and ashrama;
and the conclusion of Vedanta I do not find [with them]:
not understanding, they say many things.

অন্যোন্যে বিরোধ কেনে, ইহা নাহি অনুমানে,
কহে পুনঃ একই অদ্বৈত ।
না বুঝি তোমার মর্ম, পক্ষ ধরি করে কর্ম,
তোর কথা সর্ব-অবিদিত ॥ ৫৩৭ ॥

anyonye birodha kene, ihā nāhi anumāne,
kahe punaḥ ekai adbaita |
nā bujhi tomāra marma, pakṣa dhari kare karma,
tora kathā sarba-abidita || 537 ||

anyonye virodha kene — why there is mutual contradiction; iha nahi anumane — they do not consider; kahe punah ekai advaita — again they say: one, non-dual; na bujhi tomara marma — not understanding Your heart; paksha dhari kare karma — holding to a side, perform rites; tora katha sarva-avidita — Your word is unknown to all

537Why there is contradiction among them they do not consider,
and again they say, 'All is one, non-dual'.
Not understanding Your heart, each holding to his side, they perform their rites —
Your word is unknown to all.

এবে পদ-পরসাদে, নিরবধি প্রাণ কাঁদে,
ছাড়ি ইহা প্রাকৃত-মূরতি ।
পুনঃ জনমিয়ে আর, করি কৃষ্ণ-সংসার,
আচরিয়ে এই প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৫৩৮ ॥

ebe pada-parasāde, nirabadhi prāṇa kāṁde,
chāṛi ihā prākṛta-mūrati |
punaḥ janamiẏe āra, kari kṛṣṇa-saṃsāra,
ācariẏe ei premabhakti || 538 ||

ebe pada-parasade — now by the grace of the feet; niravadhi prana kande — the heart weeps unceasingly; chhadi iha prakrita-murati — leaving this perishable form; punah janamiye ara — may I be born again; kari krishna-samsara — making Krishna my world; achariye ei prema-bhakti — may I practise this prema-bhakti

538Now by the grace of [Your] feet my heart weeps unceasingly:
leaving this perishable form,
may I be born again, make Krishna my whole world
and practise this prema-bhakti."1

এছন নারদবাণী, শুনি কহে গুণমণি,
চল চল চল মুনিরাজ ।
কলিলোক নিস্তারিব, নিজভক্তি প্রচারিব,
জনমিব নদিয়া-সমাজ ॥ ৫৩৯ ॥

echana nāradabāṇī, śuni kahe guṇamaṇi,
cala cala cala munirāja |
kaliloka nistāriba, nijabhakti pracāriba,
janamiba nadiẏā-samāja || 539 ||

aichhana narada-vani — such words of Narada; shuni kahe gunamani — hearing, the Jewel of virtues says; chala chala chala muniraja — go, go, go, king of sages; kali-loka nistariba — I shall deliver the people of Kali; nija-bhakti prachariba — I shall spread devotion to Myself; janamiba nadiya-samaja — I shall be born among the people of Nadiya

539Hearing such words of Narada, the Jewel of virtues says:
"Go, go, go, king of sages!
I shall deliver the people of Kali, spread devotion to Myself,
I shall be born among the people of Nadia.

পৃথিবী চলহ তুমি, শ্বেতদ্বীপে আছি আমি,
বলরাম নাম সহোদর ।
অনন্ত যাহার অংশ, একাদশ রুদ্রবংশ,
সেবা করে মহেশ ঈশ্বর ॥ ৫৪০ ॥

pṛthibī calaha tumi, śbetadbīpe āchi āmi,
balarāma nāma sahodara |
ananta yāhāra aṃśa, ekādaśa rudrabaṃśa,
sebā kare maheśa īśbara || 540 ||

prithivi chalaha tumi — go to the earth; shvetadvipe achhi ami — in Shvetadvipa I abide; balarama nama sahodara — a brother named Balarama; ananta yahara amsha — Ananta is His portion; ekadasha rudra-vamsha — the eleven Rudras His line; seva kare mahesha ishvara — Lord Mahesha serves

540Go [down] to the earth: in Shvetadvipa I abide
[in the form of] a brother named Balarama;
Ananta is His portion, the eleven Rudras are His line,
Lord Mahesha serves Him.2

রেবতী-রমণী-সঙ্গে, আছয়ে বিলাস-রঙ্গে,
ক্ষীরজলনিধি-মহী-মাঝে ।
যত অবতার হয়, সেই মাত্র সহায়,
আগে করি করি নিজ কাজে ॥ ৫৪১ ॥

rebatī-ramaṇī-saṅge, āchaẏe bilāsa-raṅge,
kṣīrajalanidhi-mahī-mājhe |
yata abatāra haẏa, sei mātra sahāẏa,
āge kari kari nija kāje || 541 ||

revati-ramani-sange — with His beloved Revati; achhaye vilasa-range — abides in joyful play; kshira-jalanidhi-mahi-majhe — amid the land in the Ocean of Milk; yata avatara haya — whatever avataras there are; sei matra sahaya — He alone is the helper; age kari kari nija kaje — in My own work I place Him first

541With His beloved Revati He dwells in joyful play
amid the land in the Ocean of Milk;
whatever avataras there are, He alone is their helper;
in every work of Mine I place Him first.

চল চল মুনিরাজ, গোচর করহ কাজ,
কহিও করিয়া পরবন্ধ ।
নিজ নিজ অংশ লঞা, পৃথিবীতে জনম গিয়া,
স্বনাম ধরহ নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ৫৪২ ॥

cala cala munirāja, gocara karaha kāja,
kahio kariẏā parabandha |
nija nija aṃśa lañā, pṛthibīte janama giẏā,
sbanāma dharaha nityānanda || 542 ||

chala chala muniraja — go, go, king of sages; gochara karaha kaja — make the task known; kahio kariya parabandha — tell in due order; nija nija amsha lana — taking all Your portions; prithivite janama giya — going to take birth on earth; svanama dharaha nityananda — bear the name Nityananda

542Go, go, king of sages, make this task known to Him,
tell Him all in due order:
'Taking all Your portions, go and take birth on earth,
and bear the name Nityananda.'"

আনন্দে নারদমুনি, শুনিঞা ঠাকুরবাণী,
হিয়াসুখে বোলে হরিবোল ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস, এ দোঁহার সম্ভাষ,
শুনি উঠে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ৫৪৩ ॥

ānande nāradamuni, śuniñā ṭhākurabāṇī,
hiẏāsukhe bole haribola |
kahaẏe locanadāsa, e doṁhāra sambhāṣa,
śuni uṭhe ānanda-hillola || 543 ||

anande naradamuni — in bliss Narada Muni; shunina thakura-vani — hearing the Lord's words; hiya-sukhe bole haribola — from the joy of his heart cries "Haribol!"; kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa; e donhara sambhasha — the conversation of these two; shuni uthe ananda-hillola — hearing it, a wave of bliss arises

543In bliss Narada Muni, hearing the Lord's words,
cries "Haribol!" from the joy of his heart.
Says Lochana Dasa: whoever hears the conversation of these two,
in him a wave of bliss arises.

Raga dhanashi, short metre; disha: "I give myself to the crimson lotus feet! Go, go, give out prema, madden the world with prema!"

নারদে বিদায় দিয়া বসিলা ঠাকুর ।
আপন অন্তর-কথা তুলিলা অঙ্কুর ॥ ৫৪৪ ॥

nārade bidāẏa diẏā basilā ṭhākura |
āpana antara-kathā tulilā aṅkura || 544 ||

narade vidaya diya — having dismissed Narada; basila thakura — the Lord sat; apana antara-katha — the words of His heart; tulila ankura — sprang up as a shoot

544Having sent Narada off, the Lord sat down,
and the words of His heart sprang up like a shoot.

পৃথিবীতে জনম লভিব যে কারণে ।
তত্ত্ব কহি সর্বজন শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৫৪৫ ॥

pṛthibīte janama labhiba ye kāraṇe |
tattba kahi sarbajana śuna sābadhāne || 545 ||

prithivite janama labhiba — He will be born on earth; ye karane — for what reason; tattva kahi — I tell the essence; sarvajana shuna savadhane — listen, all, attentively

545For what reason He will be born on earth —
I shall tell the essence; listen, all, attentively.

নিজবৃন্দ লঞা প্রভু কহে নিজকথা ।
মহামহেশ্বর করে পৃথিবীর চিন্তা ॥ ৫৪৬ ॥

nijabṛnda lañā prabhu kahe nijakathā |
mahāmaheśbara kare pṛthibīra cintā || 546 ||

nija-vrinda lana — gathering His own; prabhu kahe nija-katha — the Lord speaks of Himself; maha-maheshvara — the Supreme Lord of lords; kare prithivira chinta — thinks of the earth

546Gathering His own, the Lord speaks of Himself:
the Supreme Lord of lords is thinking of the earth.

ডাহিনে রাধিকা বামে দেবী শ্রীরুক্মিণী ।
তাহার অন্তরে যত প্রধান রঙ্গিণী ॥ ৫৪৭ ॥

ḍāhine rādhikā bāme debī śrīrukmiṇī |
tāhāra antare yata pradhāna raṅgiṇī || 547 ||

dahine radhika — on the right Radhika; vame devi shri-rukmini — on the left the goddess Sri Rukmini; tahara antare — next to them; yata pradhana rangini — all the chief companions of play

547On the right is Radhika, on the left the goddess Sri Rukmini,
nearest to them all the chief companions of play,

তাহার অন্তরে যত প্রিয় পারিষদ ।
তাহার অন্তরে যত আর অনুগত ॥ ৫৪৮ ॥

tāhāra antare yata priẏa pāriṣada |
tāhāra antare yata āra anugata || 548 ||

tahara antare — after them; yata priya parishada — all the dear associates; tahara antare — after them; yata ara anugata — all the other followers

548after them all the dear associates,
after them all the other followers.

প্রাণনাথ-প্রিয়কথা শুনিব শ্রবণে ।
লাখ লাখ আঁখি এক সুন্দর বদনে ॥ ৫৪৯ ॥

prāṇanātha-priẏakathā śuniba śrabaṇe |
lākha lākha āṁkhi eka sundara badane || 549 ||

prananatha-priya-katha — the dear words of the Lord of their life; shuniba shravane — to hear with their ears; lakha lakha ankhi — hundreds of thousands of eyes; eka sundara vadane — on one beautiful face

549Longing to hear the dear words of the Lord of their life,
hundreds of thousands of eyes [are fixed] on one beautiful face:

অনেক চকোর যেন একচন্দ্র-আশে ।
পিবই অমিয়া রাশি মুখ-পরকাশে ॥ ৫৫০ ॥

aneka cakora yena ekacandra-āśe |
pibai amiẏā rāśi mukha-parakāśe || 550 ||

aneka chakora yena — like many chakoras; eka-chandra-ashe — hoping for one moon; pibai amiya rashi — drink heaps of nectar; mukha-parakashe — from the shining face

550like many chakoras hoping for one moon,
they drink heaps of nectar from the shining face.

যুগে যুগে জন্ম মোর পৃথিবীর মাঝে ।
সাধুজন-ত্রাণ ধর্ম রাখিবার কাজে ॥ ৫৫১ ॥

yuge yuge janma mora pṛthibīra mājhe |
sādhujana-trāṇa dharma rākhibāra kāje || 551 ||

yuge yuge — yuga after yuga; janma mora prithivira majhe — My birth on earth; sadhu-jana-trana — the deliverance of the righteous; dharma rakhibara kaje — for the protection of dharma

551"Yuga after yuga I take birth on earth
to deliver the righteous and to protect dharma.3

ধর্মসংস্থাপন করি না বুঝই কেহো ।
অধিকে বাঢ়য়ে পাপ পরমাদ সেহো ॥ ৫৫২ ॥

dharmasaṃsthāpana kari nā bujhai keho |
adhike bāṛhaẏe pāpa paramāda seho || 552 ||

dharma-samsthapana kari — I establish dharma; na bujhai keho — no one understands; adhike badhaye papa — sin grows even more; paramada seho — that is a calamity

552I establish dharma — but no one understands,
and sin grows ever more: what a calamity!

সত্যযুগ-অধিক ত্রেতায় বাড়ে পাপ ।
দ্বাপরে তাহার অধিক এ বড় সন্তাপ ॥ ৫৫৩ ॥

satyayuga-adhika tretāẏa bāṛe pāpa |
dbāpare tāhāra adhika e baṛa santāpa || 553 ||

satya-yuga-adhika — more than in the Satya-yuga; tretaya bade papa — in the Treta sin grows; dvapare tahara adhika — in the Dvapara more still; e bada santapa — this is great sorrow

553More than in the Satya-yuga sin grows in the Treta,
in the Dvapara still more: great is the sorrow!

কলি ঘোর অন্ধকার নাহি ধর্মলেশ ।
করুণা বাড়িল দেখি সর্বজন-ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৫৪ ॥

kali ghora andhakāra nāhi dharmaleśa |
karuṇā bāṛila dekhi sarbajana-kleśa || 554 ||

kali ghora andhakara — Kali is pitch darkness; nahi dharma-lesha — not a trace of dharma; karuna badila — compassion grew; dekhi sarvajana-klesha — seeing the sufferings of all

554Kali is pitch darkness, not a trace of dharma is there;
seeing the sufferings of all, I am filled with compassion.

অধর্ম-বিনাশ-হেতু মোর অবতার ।
অধর্ম বাঢ়য়ে পুনঃ কি কাজ আমার ॥ ৫৫৫ ॥

adharma-bināśa-hetu mora abatāra |
adharma bāṛhaẏe punaḥ ki kāja āmāra || 555 ||

adharma-vinasha-hetu — for the destruction of adharma; mora avatara — My descent; adharma badhaye punah — [if] adharma grows again; ki kaja amara — what is My work

555My descent is for the destruction of adharma;
if adharma grows again, what then is My work?

এছন জানিঞা দয়া উপজিল চিতে ।
জনম লভিব নিজ প্রেম প্রকাশিতে ॥ ৫৫৬ ॥

echana jāniñā daẏā upajila cite |
janama labhiba nija prema prakāśite || 556 ||

aichhana janina — knowing this; daya upajila chite — compassion arose in the heart; janama labhiba — I shall take birth; nija prema prakashite — to reveal My prema

556Knowing this, compassion arose in My heart:
I shall take birth to reveal My prema.

এমত দুর্লভ প্রেমভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া ।
বুঝাইব লোকে ধর্মাধর্ম বিচারিয়া ॥ ৫৫৭ ॥

emata durlabha premabhakti prakāśiẏā |
bujhāiba loke dharmādharma bicāriẏā || 557 ||

emata durlabha prema-bhakti — such rare prema-bhakti; prakashiya — revealing; bujhaiba loke — I shall make people understand; dharmadharma vichariya — discerning dharma and adharma

557Revealing such rare prema-bhakti,
I shall make people understand, discerning dharma from adharma.

নবদ্বীপে জন্ম মোর শচীর উদরে ।
গঙ্গার সমীপে জগন্নাথমিশ্র-ঘরে ॥ ৫৫৮ ॥

nabadbīpe janma mora śacīra udare |
gaṅgāra samīpe jagannāthamiśra-ghare || 558 ||

navadvipe janma mora — My birth in Navadvipa; shachira udare — from the womb of Shachi; gangara samipe — near the Ganga; jagannatha-mishra-ghare — in the house of Jagannatha Mishra

558I shall be born in Navadvipa, of Shachi,
near the Ganga, in the house of Jagannatha Mishra.

আর অবতার হেন অবতার নহে ।
অসুর-সংহার-হেতু পৃথিবী বিজয়ে ॥ ৫৫৯ ॥

āra abatāra hena abatāra nahe |
asura-saṃhāra-hetu pṛthibī bijaẏe || 559 ||

ara avatara — the other avataras; hena avatara nahe — are not like this avatara; asura-samhara-hetu — for slaying the asuras; prithivi vijaye — come to the earth

559The other avataras are not like this avatara:
they come to earth to slay the asuras.

মহাকায় মহাসুর মহা-অস্ত্র মোর ।
মহারণে সংহার করিয়া করোঁ চূর ॥ ৫৬০ ॥

mahākāẏa mahāsura mahā-astra mora |
mahāraṇe saṃhāra kariẏā karoṁ cūra || 560 ||

mahakaya mahasura — huge great asuras; maha-astra mora — with My great weapons; maharane samhara kariya — slaying in great battles; karon chura — I crushed

560Huge great asuras, with My great weapons,
in great battles I struck down and crushed.

এবে সর্বজন সেই হৃদয়-আসুরী ।
খড়্গ-ছেদ্য নহে অস্ত্রবলে কিবা করি ॥ ৫৬১ ॥

ebe sarbajana sei hṛdaẏa-āsurī |
khaṛga-chedya nahe astrabale kibā kari || 561 ||

ebe sarvajana sei — now all people; hridaya-asuri — are asuras in the heart; khadga-chhedya nahe — cannot be cut by a sword; astra-bale kiba kari — what can I do by force of arms

561But now all people are asuras in their hearts:
they cannot be cut by a sword — what can be done by force of arms?

নাম গুণ সঙ্কীর্তন বৈষ্ণবের শক্তি ।
প্রকাশ করিব আর নিজ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৫৬২ ॥

nāma guṇa saṅkīrtana baiṣṇabera śakti |
prakāśa kariba āra nija premabhakti || 562 ||

nama guna sankirtana — the name, the virtues, sankirtana; vaishnavera shakti — the Vaishnava's power; prakasha kariba ara — and further I shall reveal; nija prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti for Myself

562The name, the virtues, sankirtana — this is the Vaishnava's power;
and further I shall reveal prema-bhakti for Myself.

এই মতে কলি-পাপ করিব সংহার ।
সভে চল আগে পাছে না কর বিচার ॥ ৫৬৩ ॥

ei mate kali-pāpa kariba saṃhāra |
sabhe cala āge pāche nā kara bicāra || 563 ||

ei mate — thus; kali-papa kariba samhara — I shall destroy the sin of Kali; sabhe chala — come, all; age pachhe na kara vichara — do not consider who goes before and who after

563In this way I shall destroy the sin of Kali;
come, all, do not consider who goes before and who after.

এবে নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন খড়্গ তীক্ষ্ণ লঞা ।
অন্তর-অসুর জীবের ফেলিব কাটিয়া ॥ ৫৬৪ ॥

ebe nāma-saṅkīrtana khaṛga tīkṣṇa lañā |
antara-asura jībera pheliba kāṭiẏā || 564 ||

ebe — now; nama-sankirtana khadga tikshna lana — taking the sharp sword of the sankirtana of the name; antara-asura jivera — the asuras within the hearts of beings; pheliba katiya — I shall cut down

564Now, taking the sharp sword of the sankirtana of the name,
I shall cut down the asuras within the hearts of living beings.

যদি পাপী ছাড়ি ধর্ম দূর দেশে যায় ।
মোর সেনাপতি ভক্ত যাইবে তথায় ॥ ৫৬৫ ॥

yadi pāpī chāṛi dharma dūra deśe yāẏa |
mora senāpati bhakta yāibe tathāẏa || 565 ||

yadi papi — if a sinner; chhadi dharma — abandoning dharma; dura deshe yaya — goes to a distant land; mora senapati bhakta — My generals, the devotees; yaibe tathaya — will go there

565If a sinner, abandoning dharma, goes to a distant land,
My generals, the devotees, will go there.

নিজপ্রেমে ভাসাইব এ ব্রহ্মাণ্ড সব ।
কভু না রাখিব দুঃখ-শোক এক-লব ॥ ৫৬৬ ॥

nijapreme bhāsāiba e brahmāṇḍa saba |
kabhu nā rākhiba duḥkha-śoka eka-laba || 566 ||

nija-preme bhasaiba — with My prema I shall flood; e brahmanda saba — this whole universe; kabhu na rakhiba — I shall never leave; duhkha-shoka eka-laba — a drop of grief and sorrow

566With My prema I shall flood this whole universe
and not leave a single drop of grief and sorrow.

ভাসাইব স্থাবর জঙ্গম দেবগণে ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কহে এ দাস লোচনে ॥ ৫৬৭ ॥

bhāsāiba sthābara jaṅgama debagaṇe |
śuni ānandita kahe e dāsa locane || 567 ||

bhasaiba — I shall flood; sthavara jangama devagane — the unmoving, the moving and the gods; shuni anandita — hearing, joyfully; kahe e dasa lochane — speaks this servant Lochana

567I shall flood the moving and the unmoving, and the gods."
Hearing this, joyfully speaks this servant Lochana.

Raga varadi, tripadi metre

চলিলা নারদমুনি, উঠিল বীণার ধ্বনি,
পাণি-পদ না চলয়ে আর ।
যাইতে না পথ দেখে, প্রেমজলে আঁখি ঝাঁপে,
টলমল যেন মাতোয়ার ॥ ৫৬৮ ॥

calilā nāradamuni, uṭhila bīṇāra dhbani,
pāṇi-pada nā calaẏe āra |
yāite nā patha dekhe, premajale āṁkhi jhāṁpe,
ṭalamala yena mātoẏāra || 568 ||

chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; uthila vinara dhvani — the sound of the vina arose; pani-pada na chalaye ara — hands and feet no longer move; yaite na patha dekhe — going, he does not see the way; prema-jale ankhi jhanpe — tears of prema flood the eyes; talamala yena matoyara — staggering as if drunk

568Narada Muni set out, the sound of his vina arose;
his hands and feet no longer obey him;
he walks but does not see the way — tears of prema flood his eyes —
he staggers as if drunk.

পদ দুই চারি যাই, পুনঃ পড়ে সেই ঠাঁই,
প্রভু-নাম আধ আধ বোলে ।
অনেক শকতি উঠি, ধরিয়া ধরণী কোঁড়ি,
নদী বহে নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫৬৯ ॥

pada dui cāri yāi, punaḥ paṛe sei ṭhāṁi,
prabhu-nāma ādha ādha bole |
aneka śakati uṭhi, dhariẏā dharaṇī koṁṛi,
nadī bahe naẏanera jale || 569 ||

pada dui chari yai — going two or four steps; punah pade sei thani — falls again on that spot; prabhu-nama adha adha bole — half utters the Lord's name; aneka shakati uthi — rising with great effort; dhariya dharani kondri — clutching at the ground; nadi vahe nayanera jale — a river flows with the tears of his eyes

569He goes two or four steps and falls again on the same spot,
half uttering the name of the Lord;
with great effort he rises, clutching at the ground,4
and a river of tears flows from his eyes.

ক্ষণে মহা উনমাদ, হুহুঙ্কার সিংহনাদ,
গোরারূপ হিয়ে ধেয়ান ।
বাহ্য নাহি অন্তরে, না চিনে আপনা পরে,
সবে এক গৌর-গেয়ান ॥ ৫৭০ ॥

kṣaṇe mahā unamāda, huhuṅkāra siṃhanāda,
gorārūpa hiẏe dheẏāna |
bāhya nāhi antare, nā cine āpanā pare,
sabe eka gaura-geẏāna || 570 ||

kshane maha unamada — now great madness; huhunkara simhanada — cries of "hum!", a lion's roar; gorarupa hiye dheyana — meditation on Gora's form in the heart; bahya nahi antare — no outer awareness; na chine apana pare — does not tell himself from others; sabe eka gaura-geyana — in all only the awareness of Gaura

570Now great madness, cries of "hum!", a lion's roar,
in his heart meditation on Gora's form;
he has no outer awareness, does not tell himself from others —
in all there is only the awareness of Gaura.

কোটি-রবি-তেজঃ যেন, অঙ্গের কিরণ হেন,
নারদ চলিলা অন্তরীক্ষে ।
উত্তরিলা সেই ঠাম, যথা প্রভু বলরাম,
চমক লাগিল শ্বেতদ্বীপে ॥ ৫৭১ ॥

koṭi-rabi-tejaḥ yena, aṅgera kiraṇa hena,
nārada calilā antarīkṣe |
uttarilā sei ṭhāma, yathā prabhu balarāma,
camaka lāgila śbetadbīpe || 571 ||

koti-ravi-tejah yena — like the splendour of millions of suns; angera kirana hena — such the radiance of his body; narada chalila antarikshe — Narada flies through the sky; uttarila sei thama — descended at that abode; yatha prabhu balarama — where Lord Balarama is; chamaka lagila shvetadvipe — Shvetadvipa flashed with light

571Like the splendour of millions of suns — such is the radiance of his body;
Narada flies through the sky
and descended at that abode where Lord Balarama is —
Shvetadvipa was lit up.

পুরী-পরিসরে রহি, চমকি চৌদিকে চাহি,
লাখ লাখ হিমকর-দ্যুতি ।
বায়ু বহে মন্দ মন্দ, দিব্য সুকুসুম-গন্ধ,
প্রতিদ্বারে লম্বে গজমতি ॥ ৫৭২ ॥

purī-parisare rahi, camaki caudike cāhi,
lākha lākha himakara-dyuti |
bāẏu bahe manda manda, dibya sukusuma-gandha,
pratidbāre lambe gajamati || 572 ||

puri-parisare rahi — stopping at the city's bounds; chamaki chaudike chahi — looks in amazement on all sides; lakha lakha himakara-dyuti — the radiance of hundreds of thousands of moons; vayu vahe manda manda — a soft breeze blows; divya sukusuma-gandha — divine fragrance of flowers; pratidvare lambe gajamati — pearls hang at every gate

572Stopping at the city's bounds, he looks in amazement on every side:
the radiance of hundreds of thousands of moons;
a soft, soft breeze blows, [bearing] the divine fragrance of flowers,
pearls hang at every gate.

সত্ত্বগুণ সর্বলোক, নাহি জরা মৃত্যু শোক,
সর্বজন সভাকার বন্ধু ।
যখন যে দিগে দিঠি, সেই সর্বজন মিঠি,
বলদেবময় ক্ষীরসিন্ধু ॥ ৫৭৩ ॥

sattbaguṇa sarbaloka, nāhi jarā mṛtyu śoka,
sarbajana sabhākāra bandhu |
yakhana ye dige diṭhi, sei sarbajana miṭhi,
baladebamaẏa kṣīrasindhu || 573 ||

sattvaguna sarvaloka — all people in sattva; nahi jara mrityu shoka — no old age, death, sorrow; sarvajana sabhakara bandhu — everyone a friend of all; yakhana ye dige dithi — wherever one looks; sei sarvajana mithi — all people are lovely; baladevamaya kshirasindhu — the Ocean of Milk is full of Baladeva

573All the people there are in sattva; there is no old age, death or sorrow;
everyone is the friend of all;
wherever one looks, all the people are lovely;
the Ocean of Milk is full of Baladeva.

দেখিয়া নারদমুনি, ধনি ধনি মনে গণি,
ধনি ধনি আপনাকে মানে ।
ত্রিজগত-নাথ স্বামী, দেখিব নয়ানে আমি,
কান্দিয়া পড়িব দু-চরণে ॥ ৫৭৪ ॥

dekhiẏā nāradamuni, dhani dhani mane gaṇi,
dhani dhani āpanāke māne |
trijagata-nātha sbāmī, dekhiba naẏāne āmi,
kāndiẏā paṛiba du-caraṇe || 574 ||

dekhiya naradamuni — seeing, Narada Muni; dhani dhani mane gani — counting "blessed, blessed" in his mind; dhani dhani apanake mane — deems himself blessed; trijagata-natha svami — the Lord of the three worlds, the Master; dekhiba nayane ami — I shall see with my eyes; kandiya padiba du-charane — weeping I shall fall at His feet

574Seeing this, Narada Muni says in his mind, "Blessed, blessed!"
and counts himself blessed, blessed:
"The Lord of the three worlds, the Master, I shall see with my eyes
and fall weeping at His feet.

সেই বলরামরায়, যুগে যুগে সহায়,
করি কৃষ্ণ করে অবতার ।
খেলায় বিবিধ খেলা, অনন্ত-বিনোদ-লীলা,
করি করে অসুর-সংহার ॥ ৫৭৫ ॥

sei balarāmarāẏa, yuge yuge sahāẏa,
kari kṛṣṇa kare abatāra |
khelāẏa bibidha khelā, ananta-binoda-līlā,
kari kare asura-saṃhāra || 575 ||

sei balaramaraya — this Lord Balarama; yuge yuge sahaya — the helper yuga after yuga; kari krishna kare avatara — making [Him so], Krishna descends; khelaya vividha khela — playing games of every kind; ananta-vinoda-lila — in endless joyful lilas; kari kare asura-samhara — destroys the asuras

575This Lord Balarama is the helper yuga after yuga:
making Him [His helper], Krishna descends;
playing games of every kind, in endless joyful lilas
He destroys the asuras.

সেই প্রভু বলরাম, নিজ অংশে তিন ঠাম,
রহি করে কৃষ্ণের পীরিতি ।
আদ্য মধ্য আর অন্ত, যার অংশ অনন্ত,
এক-ফণায় ধরি রহে ক্ষিতি ॥ ৫৭৬ ॥

sei prabhu balarāma, nija aṃśe tina ṭhāma,
rahi kare kṛṣṇera pīriti |
ādya madhya āra anta, yāra aṃśa ananta,
eka-phaṇāẏa dhari rahe kṣiti || 576 ||

sei prabhu balarama — this Lord Balarama; nija amshe tina thama — by His portions in three abodes; rahi kare krishnera piriti — abiding, serves Krishna with love; adya madhya ara anta — beginning, middle and end; yara amsha ananta — His portion is Ananta; eka-phanaya dhari rahe kshiti — holds the earth on one hood

576This Lord Balarama, by His portions in three abodes,5
abides and serves Krishna with love;
at the beginning, the middle and the end — His portion is Ananta,
who holds the earth upon one hood.

আপনে ঈশ্বর হঞা, শ্বেতদ্বীপ-মাঝে রঞা,
বিলাস করয়ে নানারঙ্গে ।
সর্বোপরি পরিণাম, সেই মহাপ্রভু-ঠাম,
সেবা করে অপরূপ রঙ্গে ॥ ৫৭৭ ॥

āpane īśbara hañā, śbetadbīpa-mājhe rañā,
bilāsa karaẏe nānāraṅge |
sarbopari pariṇāma, sei mahāprabhu-ṭhāma,
sebā kare aparūpa raṅge || 577 ||

apane ishvara hana — Himself being the Lord; shvetadvipa-majhe rana — dwelling in Shvetadvipa; vilasa karaye nana-range — enjoys pastimes in many ways; sarvopari parinama — the highest fulfilment; sei mahaprabhu-thama — with that Mahaprabhu; seva kare aparupa range — He serves in wondrous ways

577Himself being the Lord, dwelling in Shvetadvipa,
He enjoys pastimes in many ways;
His highest fulfilment is service
to that Mahaprabhu, in wondrous ways.

গমনের কালে ছত্র, বসিতে আসন বস্ত্র,
শয়নের কালে হয় শয্যা ।
প্রলয়ে সে বটপত্র, মহারণে দিব্য অস্ত্র,
নানারূপে করে পরিচর্যা ॥ ৫৭৮ ॥

gamanera kāle chatra, basite āsana bastra,
śaẏanera kāle haẏa śayyā |
pralaẏe se baṭapatra, mahāraṇe dibya astra,
nānārūpe kare paricaryā || 578 ||

gamanera kale chhatra — when He walks, the umbrella; basite asana vastra — when He sits, the seat and garments; shayanera kale haya shayya — when He lies, the bed; pralaye se vatapatra — at dissolution the banyan leaf; maharane divya astra — in great battle the divine weapon; nana-rupe kare paricharya — serves in many forms

578When [the Lord] walks he is the umbrella, when He sits the seat and garments,
when He lies down the bed;
at the dissolution the banyan leaf, in great battle the divine weapon:
in many forms he serves.

এক অংশে সেবা করে, আর অংশে মহী ধরে,
হেন প্রভু বলরাম মোর ।
ত্রিজগত-অধিরাজ, দেখিব ক্ষীরোদ-মাঝ,
প্রভু-আজ্ঞা করিব গোচর ॥ ৫৭৯ ॥

eka aṃśe sebā kare, āra aṃśe mahī dhare,
hena prabhu balarāma mora |
trijagata-adhirāja, dekhiba kṣīroda-mājha,
prabhu-ājñā kariba gocara || 579 ||

eka amshe seva kare — with one portion He serves; ara amshe mahi dhare — with another holds the earth; hena prabhu balarama mora — such is my Lord Balarama; trijagata-adhiraja — the supreme King of the three worlds; dekhiba kshiroda-majha — I shall see amid the Ocean of Milk; prabhu-ajna kariba gochara — I shall convey the Lord's command

579With one portion He serves, with another portion He holds the earth —
such is my Lord Balarama.
The supreme King of the three worlds I shall see amid the Ocean of Milk
and convey to Him the Lord's command."

এই দুই প্রভু মাত্র, যেন রাজা মহাপাত্র,
পৃথিবী পালয়ে এক-যুক্তি ।
আর যত রুদ্রবংশ, সেহো যার অংশাংশ,
অবতার করিবেন ক্ষিতি ॥ ৫৮০ ॥

ei dui prabhu mātra, yena rājā mahāpātra,
pṛthibī pālaẏe eka-yukti |
āra yata rudrabaṃśa, seho yāra aṃśāṃśa,
abatāra karibena kṣiti || 580 ||

ei dui prabhu matra — these two Lords; yena raja mahapatra — like a king and chief minister; prithivi palaye eka-yukti — protect the earth with one counsel; ara yata rudra-vamsha — and all others of the Rudras' line; seho yara amshamsha — they too, portions of His portions; avatara karibena kshiti — will descend to earth

580These two Lords are like a king and his chief minister:
with one counsel they protect the earth;
and all the others of the Rudras' line — they too, portions of His portions —
will descend to earth.

হেন মনঃকথা-রসে, মুনি ভেল পরবশে,
পুরী প্রবেশিল মহানন্দে ।
দেখি ত্রিজগত-নাথ, সব-পারিষদ সাথ,
অপরূপ বলরামচান্দে ॥ ৫৮১ ॥

hena manaḥkathā-rase, muni bhela parabaśe,
purī prabeśila mahānande |
dekhi trijagata-nātha, saba-pāriṣada sātha,
aparūpa balarāmacānde || 581 ||

hena manah-katha-rase — in the rasa of these thoughts; muni bhela parabashe — the sage was beside himself; puri praveshila mahanande — entered the city in great bliss; dekhi trijagata-natha — saw the Lord of the three worlds; saba-parishada satha — with all associates; aparupa balarama-chande — the wondrous moon-like Balarama

581Absorbed in the rasa of these thoughts, the sage, beside himself,
entered the city in great bliss
and beheld the Lord of the three worlds with all His associates —
the wondrous moon-like Balarama.

অমৃত-পর্বত যেন, বসি শ্বেত-সিংহাসন,
অমৃত-মধুর লহু হাসে ।
রাতা-উতপল আঁখি, ঢুলু ঢুলু হেন দেখি,
আধবাণী মুখেতে নিকষে ॥ ৫৮২ ॥

amṛta-parbata yena, basi śbeta-siṃhāsana,
amṛta-madhura lahu hāse |
rātā-utapala āṁkhi, ḍhulu ḍhulu hena dekhi,
ādhabāṇī mukhete nikaṣe || 582 ||

amrita-parvata yena — like a mountain of nectar; basi shveta-simhasana — sitting on a white throne; amrita-madhura lahu hase — smiles softly, sweet as nectar; rata-utapala ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; dhulu dhulu hena dekhi — seen drooping languidly; adha-vani mukhete nikashe — half-words come from the lips

582Like a mountain of nectar He sits on a white throne,6
smiling softly, sweet as nectar;
His eyes red lotuses, seen drooping languidly,
half-words come from His lips.

তারক ভ্রমরা আধ, আচ্ছাদিল তার সাথ,
আধ উদাস দুই আঁখি ।
মণি মুকুতা প্রবাল, দিব্য রত্নময় হার,
অঙ্গ অলঙ্কারে নাহি লখি ॥ ৫৮৩ ॥

tāraka bhramarā ādha, ācchādila tāra sātha,
ādha udāsa dui āṁkhi |
maṇi mukutā prabāla, dibya ratnamaẏa hāra,
aṅga alaṅkāre nāhi lakhi || 583 ||

taraka bhramara adha — the bee-like pupils half; achchhadila tara satha — covered [by the lids]; adha udasa dui ankhi — both eyes half drowsy; mani mukuta pravala — gems, pearls, coral; divya ratnamaya hara — divine jewelled necklaces; anga alankare nahi lakhi — the limbs not seen for ornaments

583The pupils, like bees, are half covered [by the lids],
both eyes half drowsy;
gems, pearls, coral, divine necklaces of jewels —
the limbs cannot be seen for the ornaments.

আলিস-বালিশ করে, বামকর করি শিরে,
ডাহিনে রেবতী-কর ধরে ।
রেবতী তাম্বুল করে, দেই প্রভু-অধরে,
অনুরাগে বয়ান নেহারে ॥ ৫৮৪ ॥

ālisa-bāliśa kare, bāmakara kari śire,
ḍāhine rebatī-kara dhare |
rebatī tāmbula kare, dei prabhu-adhare,
anurāge baẏāna nehāre || 584 ||

alisa-balisha kare — leaning idly on a pillow; vamakara kari shire — left hand under his head; dahine revati-kara dhare — with the right holds Revati's hand; revati tambula kare — Revati, betel in hand; dei prabhu-adhare — puts it to her lord's lips; anurage bayana nehare — lovingly gazes at his face

584Leaning idly on a pillow, his left hand under his head,
with his right he holds Revati's hand;
Revati, betel in hand, puts it to his lips
and gazes lovingly at his face.

অনুচরী চারি-পাশে, চামর ঢুলায় হাসে,
কঙ্কণ-কিঙ্কিণী-ধ্বনি শুনি ।
কেহো বীণা বেণু বায়, কেহো বা সঙ্গীত গায়,
তাল সঞ্চে পরম-রমণী ॥ ৫৮৫ ॥

anucarī cāri-pāśe, cāmara ḍhulāẏa hāse,
kaṅkaṇa-kiṅkiṇī-dhbani śuni |
keho bīṇā beṇu bāẏa, keho bā saṅgīta gāẏa,
tāla sañce parama-ramaṇī || 585 ||

anuchari chari-pashe — maidservants on every side; chamara dhulaya hase — smiling, wave chamaras; kankana-kinkini-dhvani shuni — the tinkling of bracelets and girdle-bells is heard; keho vina venu vaya — some play the vina and flute; keho va sangita gaya — some sing; tala sanche parama-ramani — the loveliest women keep the beat

585Maidservants on every side, smiling, wave chamaras;
the tinkling of bracelets and girdle-bells is heard;
some play the vina and the flute, some sing,
the loveliest women keep the beat.

তাহার অন্তরে যত, অনুগত শত শত,
যার যেই নিজ নিয়োজিত ।
এছন সময়ে মুনি, করিল বীণার ধ্বনি,
ঠাকুর দেখিল আচম্বিত ॥ ৫৮৬ ॥

tāhāra antare yata, anugata śata śata,
yāra yei nija niẏojita |
echana samaẏe muni, karila bīṇāra dhbani,
ṭhākura dekhila ācambita || 586 ||

tahara antare yata — beyond them all; anugata shata shata — hundreds of followers; yara yei nija niyojita — each at his own appointed task; aichhana samaye muni — at that moment the sage; karila vinara dhvani — sounded his vina; thakura dekhila achambita — the Lord suddenly saw

586Beyond them are hundreds and hundreds of followers,
each at his appointed service.
At that moment the sage sounded his vina,
and the Lord suddenly saw him.

বিহ্বল নারদমুনি, টলমল পড়ে ভূমি,
ঠাকুর তুলিয়া নিল কোলে ।
চিরদিন-অনুরাগে, দেখিল সে মহাভাগে,
তুষিল শীতল মহা বোলে ॥ ৫৮৭ ॥

bihbala nāradamuni, ṭalamala paṛe bhūmi,
ṭhākura tuliẏā nila kole |
ciradina-anurāge, dekhila se mahābhāge,
tuṣila śītala mahā bole || 587 ||

vihvala naradamuni — overwhelmed, Narada Muni; talamala pade bhumi — staggering, falls to the ground; thakura tuliya nila kole — the Lord lifted him onto His lap; chiradina-anurage — with long-held love; dekhila se mahabhage — looked on that great fortunate one; tushila shitala maha bole — comforted him with cool, great words

587Overwhelmed, Narada Muni staggers and falls to the ground;
the Lord lifted him and took him on His lap,
and, with long-held love, looked on that great fortunate one
and comforted him with cool, great words.

হাসি সম্ভাষণে পহুঁ, কহ কোথা হৈতে তুহুঁ,
রহস্য কহিবে হেন বাসি ।
কহনা কেমন কাজ, শুনিতে হৃদয়-মাঝ,
আনন্দ উঠয়ে রাশি রাশি ॥ ৫৮৮ ॥

hāsi sambhāṣaṇe pahuṁ, kaha kothā haite tuhuṁ,
rahasya kahibe hena bāsi |
kahanā kemana kāja, śunite hṛdaẏa-mājha,
ānanda uṭhaẏe rāśi rāśi || 588 ||

hasi sambhashane panhu — greeting with a smile, the Lord; kaha kotha haite tuhu — say where you are from; rahasya kahibe hena basi — I feel you will tell a secret; kahana kemana kaja — tell, what is the task; shunite hridaya-majha — as I listen, within the heart; ananda uthaye rashi rashi — bliss rises in heaps

588Greeting him with a smile, the Lord says: "Where have you come from?
I feel you will tell [Me] a secret.
Tell Me, what is the task? As I listen, within My heart
bliss rises beyond counting."

সম্ভ্রমে কহয়ে মুনি, কি কহিতে জানি আমি,
তুমি প্রভু সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ।
যে কিছু কহিতে জানি, সেই কথা অনুমানি,
যে জুয়ায় কর প্রভু তুমি ॥ ৫৮৯ ॥

sambhrame kahaẏe muni, ki kahite jāni āmi,
tumi prabhu sarba-antaryāmī |
ye kichu kahite jāni, sei kathā anumāni,
ye juẏāẏa kara prabhu tumi || 589 ||

sambhrame kahaye muni — respectfully the sage says; ki kahite jani ami — what can I know how to say; tumi prabhu sarva-antaryami — You, Lord, are the Indweller of all; ye kichhu kahite jani — whatever I can say; sei katha anumani — that I say as I understand; ye juyaya kara prabhu tumi — do what is fitting, Lord

589Respectfully the sage says: "What can I know how to say?
You, Lord, are the Indweller of all.
What I can say, I shall say as I understand;
do what is fitting, Lord.

কলি পাপময় যুগে, না দেখি নিস্তার লোকে,
দয়া উপজিল প্রভু-চিতে ।
পালিব ভকতজন, আর ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন,
জনম লভিব পৃথিবীতে ॥ ৫৯০ ॥

kali pāpamaẏa yuge, nā dekhi nistāra loke,
daẏā upajila prabhu-cite |
pāliba bhakatajana, āra dharma-saṃsthāpana,
janama labhiba pṛthibīte || 590 ||

kali papamaya yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; na dekhi nistara loke — I see no deliverance for people; daya upajila prabhu-chite — compassion arose in the Lord's heart; paliba bhakata-jana — I shall protect the devotees; ara dharma-samsthapana — and establish dharma; janama labhiba prithivite — I shall be born on earth

590'In the sinful Kali-yuga I see no deliverance for people' —
compassion arose in the Lord's heart —
'to protect the devotees and establish dharma
I shall be born on earth.

অধর্ম-বিনাশ-কাজে, আর কিবা ধর্ম আছে,
হেন বুঝি আকার-ইঙ্গিতে ।
আজ্ঞা দিলা আমারে, ঘোষণা দিবার তরে,
শুনি লোক ভেল আনন্দিতে ॥ ৫৯১ ॥

adharma-bināśa-kāje, āra kibā dharma āche,
hena bujhi ākāra-iṅgite |
ājñā dilā āmāre, ghoṣaṇā dibāra tare,
śuni loka bhela ānandite || 591 ||

adharma-vinasha-kaje — for destroying adharma; ara kiba dharma achhe — what other dharma is there; hena bujhi akara-ingite — so I understood from bearing and signs; ajna dila amare — He commanded me; ghoshana dibara tare — to make the proclamation; shuni loka bhela anandite — hearing, people rejoiced

591For the destruction of adharma, what other dharma is there?' —
so I understood from His bearing and signs.
He commanded me to make the proclamation,
and on hearing it people rejoiced.

রাধাভাব অন্তরে, রাধাবর্ণ বাহিরে,
অন্তর্বাহ্য রাধাময় হঞা ।
সঙ্গে সখা-সখীবৃন্দ, আর ভক্ত অনন্ত,
ব্রজভাবে অখিল মাতাঞা ॥ ৫৯২ ॥

rādhābhāba antare, rādhābarṇa bāhire,
antarbāhya rādhāmaẏa hañā |
saṅge sakhā-sakhībṛnda, āra bhakta ananta,
brajabhābe akhila mātāñā || 592 ||

radha-bhava antare — Radha's bhava within; radha-varna bahire — Radha's colour without; antarbahya radhamaya hana — filled with Radha inside and out; sange sakha-sakhi-vrinda — with friends and girl-companions; ara bhakta ananta — and endless devotees; vraja-bhave akhila matana — maddening the whole world with the bhava of Vraja

592With the bhava of Radha within and the colour of Radha without,
filled with Radha inside and out,
with His friends and girl-companions and endless devotees
He will madden the whole world with the bhava of Vraja.7

সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে পারিষদে, জনমহ পৃথিবীতে,
স্বনাম ধরহ নিত্যানন্দ ।
তোর অগোচর নহে, তার মর্ম কর্ম দেহে,
কহিল যে আজ্ঞা গৌরচন্দ্র ॥ ৫৯৩ ॥

sāṅgopāṅge pāriṣade, janamaha pṛthibīte,
sbanāma dharaha nityānanda |
tora agocara nahe, tāra marma karma dehe,
kahila ye ājñā gauracandra || 593 ||

sanga-upange parishade — with limbs, sub-limbs and associates; janamaha prithivite — take birth on earth; svanama dharaha nityananda — bear the name Nityananda; tora agochara nahe — not unknown to You; tara marma karma dehe — the heart of His deeds and form; kahila ye ajna gaurachandra — the command Gaurachandra spoke

593'With limbs, sub-limbs and associates take birth on earth
and bear the name Nityananda' —
the heart of His deeds and form is not unknown to You —
this is the command that Gaurachandra spoke."

শুনি বলরামরায়, আনন্দে চৌদিকে চায়,
অট্ট অট্ট হাসে উচ্চনাদে ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার, প্রকাশয়ে চমৎকার,
আপনা পাসরে প্রেমানন্দে ॥ ৫৯৪ ॥

śuni balarāmarāẏa, ānande caudike cāẏa,
aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse uccanāde |
ghana ghana huhuṅkāra, prakāśaẏe camatkāra,
āpanā pāsare premānande || 594 ||

shuni balaramaraya — hearing, Lord Balarama; anande chaudike chaya — in bliss looks on every side; atta atta hase uchchanade — laughs in loud peals; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again roars "hum!"; prakashaye chamatkara — displays wonders; apana pasare premanande — forgets Himself in the bliss of prema

594Hearing this, Lord Balarama looks around in bliss
and laughs aloud with great peals;
again and again He roars "hum!", displays wonders,
forgets Himself in the bliss of prema.

আজ্ঞা দিল নিজজনে, পৃথিবী কর গমনে,
প্রভু-আজ্ঞা পালিবার তরে ।
চলহ নারদ তুমি, জনম লভিব আমি,
অগোচর করিব গোচরে ॥ ৫৯৫ ॥

ājñā dila nijajane, pṛthibī kara gamane,
prabhu-ājñā pālibāra tare |
calaha nārada tumi, janama labhiba āmi,
agocara kariba gocare || 595 ||

ajna dila nija-jane — He commanded His own; prithivi kara gamane — go to the earth; prabhu-ajna palibara tare — to carry out the Lord's command; chalaha narada tumi — go, Narada; janama labhiba ami — I shall take birth; agochara kariba gochare — I shall make the unseen seen

595He commanded His own: "Go to the earth
to carry out the Lord's command.
Go, Narada: I shall take birth
and make the unseen seen."

এছন অদ্ভুত কথা, শুন গৌর-গুণগাথা,
সর্বজন কর অবধানে ।
সব-অবতার-সার, কলি-গোরা-অবতার,
বিচার করহ সভে মনে ॥ ৫৯৬ ॥

echana adbhuta kathā, śuna gaura-guṇagāthā,
sarbajana kara abadhāne |
saba-abatāra-sāra, kali-gorā-abatāra,
bicāra karaha sabhe mane || 596 ||

aichhana adbhuta katha — such a wondrous tale; shuna gaura-guna-gatha — hear the story of Gaura's virtues; sarvajana kara avadhane — all be attentive; saba-avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; kali-gora-avatara — Gora, the avatara of Kali; vichara karaha sabhe mane — consider, all, in your minds

596Such a wondrous tale, the story of Gaura's virtues — hear it,
all of you, be attentive:
the essence of all avataras is Gora, the avatara of Kali —
consider this, all, in your minds.

তৃণ ধরি দশনে, বলোঁ মো কাতর-মনে,
গোরা-গুণে না করিহ হেলা ।
সংসারে না দিয়া মতি, কর কৃষ্ণে পীরিতি,
সংসার তরিতে এই ভেলা ॥ ৫৯৭ ॥

tṛṇa dhari daśane, baloṁ mo kātara-mane,
gorā-guṇe nā kariha helā |
saṃsāre nā diẏā mati, kara kṛṣṇe pīriti,
saṃsāra tarite ei bhelā || 597 ||

trina dhari dashane — holding a straw between the teeth; balon mo katara-mane — I say with a contrite heart; gora-gune na kariha hela — do not neglect Gora's virtues; samsare na diya mati — not giving the mind to worldly life; kara krishne piriti — love Krishna; samsara tarite ei bhela — this is the raft to cross worldly existence

597Holding a straw between my teeth, with a contrite heart I say:
do not neglect Gora's virtues;
do not give your mind to worldly life, love Krishna —
this is the raft for crossing the ocean of worldly existence.

কভু নাহি হয় যেই, গোরা-অবতার সেই,
হইব পরম-পরকাশ ।
নির্জীব জীবন পাবে, অন্ধে পথ বিচারিবে,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৫৯৮ ॥

kabhu nāhi haẏa yei, gorā-abatāra sei,
haiba parama-parakāśa |
nirjība jībana pābe, andhe patha bicāribe,
guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 598 ||

kabhu nahi haya yei — what has never been; gora-avatara sei — that Gora-avatara; haiba parama-parakasha — will be fully manifest; nirjiva jivana pabe — the lifeless will gain life; andhe patha vicharibe — the blind will discern the path; guna gaya e lochanadasa — sings the virtues this Lochana Dasa

598What has never been — that Gora-avatara
will be fully manifest;
the lifeless will gain life, the blind will discern the path —
so sings His virtues this Lochana Dasa.

Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, sing, sing the tale of the virtues of Nitai and Chaitanya!"

হেনরূপে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈলা ।
নিজ নিজ অংশে সভে জনম লভিলা ॥ ৫৯৯ ॥

henarūpe mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kailā |
nija nija aṃśe sabhe janama labhilā || 599 ||

henarupe — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu commanded; nija nija amshe — by their portions; sabhe janama labhila — all took birth

599When Mahaprabhu had so commanded,
all took birth by their portions.

মহেশঠাকুর সর্ব-আগে আগুয়ান ।
ব্রাহ্মণের কুলে জন্ম কমলাক্ষ নাম ॥ ৬০০ ॥

maheśaṭhākura sarba-āge āguẏāna |
brāhmaṇera kule janma kamalākṣa nāma || 600 ||

mahesha-thakura — Mahesha Thakura; sarva-age aguyana — went forth before all; brahmanera kule janma — born in a brahmana family; kamalaksha nama — named Kamalaksha

600Mahesha Thakura went forth before all:
He was born in a brahmana family, named Kamalaksha.

পঢ়িয়া শুনিঞা গুণে পরবীণ হৈলা ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য বলি পদবী লভিলা ॥ ৬০১ ॥

paṛhiẏā śuniñā guṇe parabīṇa hailā |
adbaita-ācārya bali padabī labhilā || 601 ||

padhiya shunina — by study and hearing; gune paravina haila — became accomplished in virtue; advaita-acharya bali — as "Advaita Acharya"; padavi labhila — received the title

601By study and hearing He became accomplished in virtue
and received the title "Advaita Acharya".8

সেই মহামহেশ্বর সত্ত্বগুণ ধরে ।
তমোগুণ বলি যারে ঘোষয়ে সংসারে ॥ ৬০২ ॥

sei mahāmaheśbara sattbaguṇa dhare |
tamoguṇa bali yāre ghoṣaẏe saṃsāre || 602 ||

sei maha-maheshvara — this great Maheshvara; sattvaguna dhare — bears sattva; tamoguna bali yare — whom as tamo-guna; ghoshaye samsare — the world proclaims

602This great Maheshvara is endowed with sattva —
yet the world proclaims Him [the embodiment of] tamo-guna.

অন্তর্বাহ্য বিচার না করে কেহো পুনঃ ।
বাহ্য আচরণ দেখি বোলে তমোগুণ ॥ ৬০৩ ॥

antarbāhya bicāra nā kare keho punaḥ |
bāhya ācaraṇa dekhi bole tamoguṇa || 603 ||

antarbahya vichara — consideration of within and without; na kare keho punah — no one makes; bahya acharana dekhi — seeing outer conduct; bole tamoguna — they say "tamo-guna"

603No one considers what He is within and without:
seeing His outer conduct, they say "tamo-guna".

কৃষ্ণের কেবল আত্মা নামে হরিহর ।
পরাকৃত তমোগুণ গুণের ভিতর ॥ ৬০৪ ॥

kṛṣṇera kebala ātmā nāme harihara |
parākṛta tamoguṇa guṇera bhitara || 604 ||

krishnera kevala atma — Krishna's very self; name harihara — named Hari-Hara; parakrita tamoguna — tamo-guna set aside (or: worldly tamo-guna); gunera bhitara — among his qualities

604[Shiva] is Krishna's very self; their name is Hari-Hara;
the worldly tamo-guna is set aside among his qualities.9

প্রাকৃত ভকত বলি যেই তমোগুণী ।
অধম বলিয়ে অল্প জনে যবে জানি ॥ ৬০৫ ॥

prākṛta bhakata bali yei tamoguṇī |
adhama baliẏe alpa jane yabe jāni || 605 ||

prakrita bhakata bali — calling him a worldly devotee; yei tamoguni — whoever [calls him] "tamoguni"; adhama baliye — I call low; alpa jane — a petty man; yabe jani — when I know

605Whoever, taking him for a worldly devotee, calls him "tamoguni" —
when I know of him, I shall call him low, a petty man.

এ কেমনে হরিহর বোল তমোগুণ ।
অবজ্ঞা না কর যবে মোর বোল শুন ॥ ৬০৬ ॥

e kemane harihara bola tamoguṇa |
abajñā nā kara yabe mora bola śuna || 606 ||

e kemane — how then; harihara bola tamoguna — you call Hari-Hara tamo-guna; avajna na kara — show no disrespect; yabe mora bola shuna — if you listen to my words

606How can you say that Hari-Hara is tamo-guna?
Show no disrespect, if you listen to my words.

মনে অনুমান করি করহ বিচার ।
এতেকে বলিয়ে গোরা অবতার-সার ॥ ৬০৭ ॥

mane anumāna kari karaha bicāra |
eteke baliẏe gorā abatāra-sāra || 607 ||

mane anumana kari — reflecting in the mind; karaha vichara — consider; eteke baliye — therefore I say; gora avatara-sara — Gora is the essence of avataras

607Reflect in your minds and consider:
this is why I say that Gora is the essence of all avataras.

সব অবতারে তার খেলার সংহতি ।
বলরাম জনম লভিলা এই ক্ষিতি ॥ ৬০৮ ॥

saba abatāre tāra khelāra saṃhati |
balarāma janama labhilā ei kṣiti || 608 ||

saba avatare — in all avataras; tara khelara samhati — companion of His play; balarama janama labhila — Balarama took birth; ei kshiti — on this earth

608In all the avataras the companion of His play,
Balarama, took birth on this earth —

ব্রাহ্মণের কুলে যুগধর্ম-অনুরূপ ।
নিত্য আনন্দকন্দ সহজ-স্বরূপ ॥ ৬০৯ ॥

brāhmaṇera kule yugadharma-anurūpa |
nitya ānandakanda sahaja-sbarūpa || 609 ||

brahmanera kule — in a brahmana family; yugadharma-anurupa — as befits the dharma of the yuga; nitya ananda-kanda — eternal root of bliss; sahaja-svarupa — His innate form

609in a brahmana family, as befits the dharma of the yuga:
the eternal (nitya) root of bliss (ananda) is His innate form.

এক অংশে যাঁহার সহস্র ফণা ধরে ।
এক ফণে মহী ধরে সৃষ্টি রাখিবারে ॥ ৬১০ ॥

eka aṃśe yāṁhāra sahasra phaṇā dhare |
eka phaṇe mahī dhare sṛṣṭi rākhibāre || 610 ||

eka amshe yanhara — one portion of whom; sahasra phana dhare — bears a thousand hoods; eka phane mahi dhare — holds the earth on one hood; srishti rakhibare — to preserve creation

610One portion of Him bears a thousand hoods,
and on one hood holds the earth to preserve creation.

পদ্মাবতী-উদরে জনম বলরাম ।
পিতা হাড়ো ওঝা সে পরমানন্দ নাম ॥ ৬১১ ॥

padmābatī-udare janama balarāma |
pitā hāṛo ojhā se paramānanda nāma || 611 ||

padmavati-udare — from the womb of Padmavati; janama balarama — Balarama was born; pita hado ojha — the father, Hado Ojha; se paramananda nama — by name also Paramananda

611Balarama was born of Padmavati;
His father was Hado Ojha, by name also Paramananda.10

পিতা মাতা নাম থুইল কুবের পণ্ডিত ।
সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রমে নিত্যানন্দ সুচরিত ॥ ৬১২ ॥

pitā mātā nāma thuila kubera paṇḍita |
sannyāsa-āśrame nityānanda sucarita || 612 ||

pita mata nama thuila — father and mother gave the name; kuvera pandita — Kuvera Pandita; sannyasa-ashrame — in the ashrama of sannyasa; nityananda sucharita — Nityananda of wondrous deeds

612His father and mother named Him Kuvera Pandita;
in the ashrama of sannyasa He is Nityananda of wondrous deeds.11

শুক্লা ত্রয়োদশী শুভযোগ মাঘমাসে ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈলা পরম হরিষে ॥ ৬১৩ ॥

śuklā traẏodaśī śubhayoga māghamāse |
pṛthibīte janama lailā parama hariṣe || 613 ||

shukla trayodashi — the bright thirteenth; shubha-yoga — under an auspicious conjunction; magha-mase — in the month of Magha; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; parama harishe — in great joy

613Under an auspicious conjunction, on the bright thirteenth of the month of Magha,
He took birth on earth in great joy.

কাত্যায়নী জনম লভিল মহী-মাঝে ।
সীতা নাম ধরে বিপ্রকুলের সমাজে ॥ ৬১৪ ॥

kātyāẏanī janama labhila mahī-mājhe |
sītā nāma dhare biprakulera samāje || 614 ||

katyayani — Katyayani; janama labhila mahi-majhe — took birth on earth; sita nama dhare — bears the name Sita; vipra-kulera samaje — in the society of brahmanas

614Katyayani took birth on earth
and bears the name Sita in the society of brahmanas.

অদ্বৈত-ঠাকুর-সঙ্গে একত্রে নিবাস ।
দোঁহে মিলি প্রেমভক্তি করে পরকাশ ॥ ৬১৫ ॥

adbaita-ṭhākura-saṅge ekatre nibāsa |
doṁhe mili premabhakti kare parakāśa || 615 ||

advaita-thakura-sange — together with Advaita Thakura; ekatre nivasa — she lives; donhe mili — the two together; prema-bhakti kare parakasha — reveal prema-bhakti

615She lives together with Advaita Thakura,
and the two together reveal prema-bhakti.

আমি অল্পবুদ্ধি কার কিবা তত্ত্ব জানি ।
অবতার-নির্ণয় বা কেমনে বাখানি ॥ ৬১৬ ॥

āmi alpabuddhi kāra kibā tattba jāni |
abatāra-nirṇaẏa bā kemane bākhāni || 616 ||

ami alpabuddhi — I am small of mind; kara kiba tattva jani — what do I know of who is what; avatara-nirnaya — determination of avataras; va kemane bakhani — how shall I expound

616I am small of mind — what do I know of who is what?
How can I expound whose avatara anyone is?

মহান্তের মুখে যেই শুনিঞাছি কাণে ।
তাহাও কহিতে নারি সঙ্কোচ পরাণে ॥ ৬১৭ ॥

mahāntera mukhe yei śuniñāchi kāṇe |
tāhāo kahite nāri saṅkoca parāṇe || 617 ||

mahantera mukhe — from the mouths of mahantas; yei shuninachhi kane — what I have heard with my ears; tahao kahite nari — even that I cannot tell; sankocha parane — my heart shrinks

617Even what I have heard with my ears from the mouths of mahantas
I cannot repeat: my heart shrinks back.

আমার শকতি নাহি করিতে নির্ণয় ।
নাম লই এইমাত্র যার যেই হয় ॥ ৬১৮ ॥

āmāra śakati nāhi karite nirṇaẏa |
nāma lai eimātra yāra yei haẏa || 618 ||

amara shakati nahi — I have no power; karite nirnaya — to determine; nama lai eimatra — I only take the names; yara yei haya — of whoever is

618I have no power to determine it —
I only name those who are.

আগে পাছে বিচার না কর কেহ মনে ।
অক্ষর-অনুরোধে গ্রন্থ নহে অনুক্রমে ॥ ৬১৯ ॥

āge pāche bicāra nā kara keha mane |
akṣara-anurodhe grantha nahe anukrame || 619 ||

age pachhe — before or after; vichara na kara keha mane — let no one consider in his mind; akshara-anurodhe — for the sake of the syllables (metre); grantha nahe anukrame — the book is not in order

619Let no one consider in his mind who is named before and who after:
for the sake of the metre the book keeps no order [of rank].

শচীদেবী জগন্নাথমিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
আপনে ঠাকুর জন্ম কৈলা যার ঘর ॥ ৬২০ ॥

śacīdebī jagannāthamiśra purandara |
āpane ṭhākura janma kailā yāra ghara || 620 ||

shachidevi — Shachi-devi; jagannatha-mishra purandara — Jagannatha Mishra Purandara; apane thakura — the Lord Himself; janma kaila yara ghara — took birth in whose house

620Shachi-devi and Jagannatha Mishra Purandara,
in whose house the Lord Himself took birth;

গোপীনাথ নাম কাশীমিশ্র ঠাকুর ।
চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৬২১ ॥

gopīnātha nāma kāśīmiśra ṭhākura |
caitanya-sammata-pathe ānanda pracura || 621 ||

gopinatha nama — Gopinatha by name; kashimishra thakura — Kashi Mishra Thakura; chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; ananda prachura — abundant bliss

621Gopinatha by name, and Kashi Mishra Thakura,12
on the path approved by Chaitanya, in abundant bliss;

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর গদাধরদাস ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৬২২ ॥

paṇḍita śrīgadādhara gadādharadāsa |
murāri mukundadatta āra śrīnibāsa || 622 ||

pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; gadadharadasa — Gadadhara Dasa; murari mukundadatta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

622Pandita Sri Gadadhara, Gadadhara Dasa,
Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa;

রায় রামানন্দ আর বাসুদেব দত্ত ।
হরিদাস ঠাকুর আর গোবিন্দ অনুগত ॥ ৬২৩ ॥

rāẏa rāmānanda āra bāsudeba datta |
haridāsa ṭhākura āra gobinda anugata || 623 ||

raya ramananda — Raya Ramananda; ara vasudeva datta — and Vasudeva Datta; haridasa thakura — Haridasa Thakura; ara govinda anugata — and Govinda the attendant

623Raya Ramananda and Vasudeva Datta,
Haridasa Thakura and Govinda the attendant;

ঈশ্বর মাধবপুরী বিষ্ণুপুরী আর ।
বক্রেশ্বর পরমানন্দপুরী শুদ্ধাচার ॥ ৬২৪ ॥

īśbara mādhabapurī biṣṇupurī āra |
bakreśbara paramānandapurī śuddhācāra || 624 ||

ishvara — Ishvara [Puri]; madhavapuri — Madhava Puri; vishnupuri ara — and Vishnupuri; vakreshvara — Vakreshvara; paramananda-puri — Paramananda Puri; shuddhachara — of pure conduct

624Ishvara [Puri], Madhava Puri and Vishnupuri,
Vakreshvara, Paramananda Puri of pure conduct;

পণ্ডিত জগদানন্দ আর বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
রাঘব পণ্ডিত আদি পৃথিবী আসিয়া ॥ ৬২৫ ॥

paṇḍita jagadānanda āra biṣṇupriẏā |
rāghaba paṇḍita ādi pṛthibī āsiẏā || 625 ||

pandita jagadananda — Pandita Jagadananda; ara vishnupriya — and Vishnupriya; raghava pandita adi — Raghava Pandita and others; prithivi asiya — coming to earth

625Pandita Jagadananda and Vishnupriya,
Raghava Pandita and others came to earth;

রামদাস গৌরীদাস আর ত সুন্দর ।
কৃষ্ণদাস পুরুষোত্তম শ্রীকমলাকর ॥ ৬২৬ ॥

rāmadāsa gaurīdāsa āra ta sundara |
kṛṣṇadāsa puruṣottama śrīkamalākara || 626 ||

ramadasa — Ramadasa; gauridasa — Gauridasa; ara ta sundara — and Sundara; krishnadasa — Krishnadasa; purushottama — Purushottama; shri-kamalakara — Sri Kamalakara

626Ramadasa, Gauridasa and Sundara,
Krishnadasa, Purushottama, Sri Kamalakara,

কালা কৃষ্ণদাস আর উদ্ধারণ দত্ত ।
দ্বাদশ গোপাল ব্রজে ইহার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৬২৭ ॥

kālā kṛṣṇadāsa āra uddhāraṇa datta |
dbādaśa gopāla braje ihāra mahattba || 627 ||

kala krishnadasa — Kala Krishnadasa; ara uddharana datta — and Uddharana Datta; dvadasha gopala vraje — the twelve gopalas of Vraja; ihara mahattva — such is their greatness

627Kala Krishnadasa and Uddharana Datta —
the twelve cowherd boys (gopalas) of Vraja: such is their greatness;13

পরমেশ্বর দাস আর বৃন্দাবন দাস ।
কাশীশ্বর শ্রীল রূপ সনাতন প্রকাশ ॥ ৬২৮ ॥

parameśbara dāsa āra bṛndābana dāsa |
kāśīśbara śrīla rūpa sanātana prakāśa || 628 ||

parameshvara dasa — Parameshvara Dasa; ara vrindavana dasa — and Vrindavana Dasa; kashishvara — Kashishvara; shrila rupa sanatana — Srila Rupa and Sanatana; prakasha — appeared

628Parameshvara Dasa and Vrindavana Dasa,
Kashishvara, Srila Rupa and Sanatana appeared;

গোবিন্দ মাধবঘোষ বাসুঘোষ আর ।
সভে মিলি আসি কৈল পৃথিবী প্রচার ॥ ৬২৯ ॥

gobinda mādhabaghoṣa bāsughoṣa āra |
sabhe mili āsi kaila pṛthibī pracāra || 629 ||

govinda — Govinda; madhava-ghosha — Madhava Ghosha; vasu-ghosha ara — and Vasu Ghosha; sabhe mili asi — all coming together; kaila prithivi prachara — spread over the earth

629Govinda, Madhava Ghosha and Vasu Ghosha —
all came together and spread [bhakti] over the earth.

দামোদর পণ্ডিত মিলিয়া পাঁচ ভাই ।
জনম লভিলা পৃথিবীতে এক ঠাঞি ॥ ৬৩০ ॥

dāmodara paṇḍita miliẏā pāṁca bhāi |
janama labhilā pṛthibīte eka ṭhāñi || 630 ||

damodara pandita miliya — together with Damodara Pandita; pancha bhai — five brothers; janama labhila prithivite — took birth on earth; eka thani — in one place

630Together with Damodara Pandita, five brothers
took birth on earth in one place.14

পুরন্দর পণ্ডিত আর পরমানন্দ বৈদ্য ।
পৃথিবী আইলা যত ছিলা অন্ত আদ্য ॥ ৬৩১ ॥

purandara paṇḍita āra paramānanda baidya |
pṛthibī āilā yata chilā anta ādya || 631 ||

purandara pandita — Purandara Pandita; ara paramananda vaidya — and Paramananda Vaidya; prithivi aila — came to earth; yata chhila anta adya — all who were, last and first

631Purandara Pandita and Paramananda Vaidya —
all who were, from the first to the last, came to earth.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
বিশেষ কহিব কিছু চরিত্র তাঁহার ॥ ৬৩২ ॥

śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |
biśeṣa kahiba kichu caritra tāṁhāra || 632 ||

shri-naraharidasa — Sri Narahari Dasa; thakura amara — my Thakura; vishesha kahiba kichhu — I shall say something in particular; charitra tanhara — of his deeds

632Sri Narahari Dasa is my Thakura:
of his deeds I shall say something in particular.

তাঁহার চরিত্র আমি কি কহিতে জানি ।
আপন বুদ্ধির শক্তি যেই অনুমানি ॥ ৬৩৩ ॥

tāṁhāra caritra āmi ki kahite jāni |
āpana buddhira śakti yei anumāni || 633 ||

tanhara charitra — of his deeds; ami ki kahite jani — what can I know how to tell; apana buddhira shakti — by the power of my mind; yei anumani — what I grasp

633What can I know how to tell of his deeds?
[I tell] only what I grasp by the power of my mind.

অভিমান কেহো কিছু না করিহ মনে ।
প্রণতি করিয়ে নিজ গুরুর চরণে ॥ ৬৩৪ ॥

abhimāna keho kichu nā kariha mane |
praṇati kariẏe nija gurura caraṇe || 634 ||

abhimana keho kichhu — any resentment, anyone; na kariha mane — let no one keep in mind; pranati kariye — I bow; nija gurura charane — at the feet of my guru

634Let no one harbour any resentment:
I bow at the feet of my own guru,

যাঁর পদ-পরসাদে আমি হেন ছার ।
তোমার ঠাকুর-গুণ কহোঁ তো সভার ॥ ৬৩৫ ॥

yāṁra pada-parasāde āmi hena chāra |
tomāra ṭhākura-guṇa kahoṁ to sabhāra || 635 ||

yanra pada-parasade — by the grace of whose feet; ami hena chhara — I, such a wretch; tomara thakura-guna — to you the Lord's virtues; kahon to sabhara — I tell all of you

635by the grace of whose feet I, such a wretch,
tell you all of the Lord's virtues.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
বৈদ্যকুলে মহাকুল-প্রভাব যাঁহার ॥ ৬৩৬ ॥

śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |
baidyakule mahākula-prabhāba yāṁhāra || 636 ||

shri-naraharidasa — Sri Narahari Dasa; thakura amara — my Thakura; vaidya-kule — in the vaidya lineage; mahakula-prabhava yanhara — whose power is the glory of the clan

636Sri Narahari Dasa is my Thakura,
whose power is the glory of the vaidya lineage.

অনর্গল কৃষ্ণপ্রেম কৃষ্ণময় তনু ।
অনুগত জনে না বুঝায় প্রেম বিনু ॥ ৬৩৭ ॥

anargala kṛṣṇaprema kṛṣṇamaẏa tanu |
anugata jane nā bujhāẏa prema binu || 637 ||

anargala krishna-prema — unchecked love for Krishna; krishnamaya tanu — a body full of Krishna; anugata jane — to followers; na bujhaya prema vinu — teaches nothing but prema

637Unchecked is his love for Krishna, his body is full of Krishna;
to his followers he teaches nothing but prema.

অসংখ্য জীবেরে দয়া কাতর হৃদয় ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুরাগে সদা অস্থির আশয় ॥ ৬৩৮ ॥

asaṃkhya jībere daẏā kātara hṛdaẏa |
kṛṣṇa-anurāge sadā asthira āśaẏa || 638 ||

asankhya jivere daya — compassion for countless beings; katara hridaya — an aching heart; krishna-anurage — with love for Krishna; sada asthira ashaya — the soul ever restless

638His heart aches with compassion for countless beings,
his soul is ever restless with love for Krishna.

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রসে তনু গঢ়িয়াছে যেন ।
ভাবের উদয় হয় যখন যেমন ॥ ৬৩৯ ॥

rādhākṛṣṇa-rase tanu gaṛhiẏāche yena |
bhābera udaẏa haẏa yakhana yemana || 639 ||

radha-krishna-rase — of the rasa of Radha and Krishna; tanu gadhiyachhe yena — the body seems moulded; bhavera udaya haya — bhavas arise; yakhana yemana — now this, now that

639His body seems moulded of the rasa of Radha and Krishna:
bhavas rise in him, now this, now that.

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রসে যাঁর নির্মল কীরিতি ।
শ্রীখণ্ড-ভূখণ্ড-মাঝে যাঁর অবস্থিতি ॥ ৬৪০ ॥

rādhākṛṣṇa-rase yāṁra nirmala kīriti |
śrīkhaṇḍa-bhūkhaṇḍa-mājhe yāṁra abasthiti || 640 ||

radha-krishna-rase — in the rasa of Radha and Krishna; yanra nirmala kiriti — his pure fame; shrikhanda-bhukhanda-majhe — in the land of Shrikhanda; yanra avasthiti — his dwelling

640In the rasa of Radha and Krishna lies his pure fame;15
he dwells in the land of Shrikhanda.

নরহরি চৈতন্য বলিয়া প্রভুর খ্যাতি ।
সে চরণ বিনু মোর আর নাহি গতি ॥ ৬৪১ ॥

narahari caitanya baliẏā prabhura khyāti |
se caraṇa binu mora āra nāhi gati || 641 ||

narahari chaitanya baliya — as "Narahari of Chaitanya"; prabhura khyati — the master is renowned; se charana vinu — apart from those feet; mora ara nahi gati — I have no other refuge

641"Narahari of Chaitanya" — so this master is renowned;
apart from his feet I have no other refuge.

ক্ষণে কৃষ্ণ ক্ষণে রাধা ভাবের আবেশে ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রস মূর্তিমন্ত পরকাশে ॥ ৬৪২ ॥

kṣaṇe kṛṣṇa kṣaṇe rādhā bhābera ābeśe |
rādhākṛṣṇa-rasa mūrtimanta parakāśe || 642 ||

kshane krishna kshane radha — now Krishna, now Radha; bhavera aveshe — rapt in the bhavas; radha-krishna-rasa murtimanta — the embodied rasa of Radha and Krishna; parakashe — he displays

642Now Krishna, now Radha — rapt in their bhavas,
he displays the rasa of Radha and Krishna embodied.

চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে সে শুদ্ধ বিচার ।
অতুল সরস ভাব সব অবতার ॥ ৬৪৩ ॥

caitanya-sammata-pathe se śuddha bicāra |
atula sarasa bhāba saba abatāra || 643 ||

chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; se shuddha vichara — his judgement is pure; atula sarasa bhava — peerless bhavas full of rasa; saba avatara — [as of] all the avataras

643On the path approved by Chaitanya his judgement is pure;
peerless and full of rasa are his bhavas, [as of] all the avataras.

সকল বৈষ্ণবে যোগ্য সম্মান পীরিতি ।
সকল সংসারে যাঁর নির্মল কীরিতি ॥ ৬৪৪ ॥

sakala baiṣṇabe yogya sammāna pīriti |
sakala saṃsāre yāṁra nirmala kīriti || 644 ||

sakala vaishnave — to all Vaishnavas; yogya sammana piriti — due honour and love; sakala samsare — in all the world; yanra nirmala kiriti — his pure fame

644To all Vaishnavas due honour and love;
through all the world his pure fame.

বৃন্দাবনে মধুমতী নাম ছিল যাঁর ।
রাধাপ্রিয় সখী তিঁহো মধুর-ভাণ্ডার ॥ ৬৪৫ ॥

bṛndābane madhumatī nāma chila yāṁra |
rādhāpriẏa sakhī tiṁho madhura-bhāṇḍāra || 645 ||

vrindavane — in Vrindavana; madhumati nama chhila yanra — whose name was Madhumati; radha-priya sakhi tinho — she was a dear companion of Radha; madhura-bhandara — a treasury of sweetness

645In Vrindavana he was named Madhumati,
a dear companion of Radha, a treasury of sweetness.16

এবে কলিকালে গৌরসঙ্গে নরহরি ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেম-ভাণ্ডারে অধিকারী ॥ ৬৪৬ ॥

ebe kalikāle gaurasaṅge narahari |
rādhākṛṣṇa-prema-bhāṇḍāre adhikārī || 646 ||

ebe kalikale — now in the Kali age; gaura-sange narahari — Narahari, companion of Gaura; radha-krishna-prema-bhandare — of the treasury of the prema of Radha and Krishna; adhikari — the keeper

646Now, in the Kali age, Narahari, companion of Gaura,
is the keeper of the treasury of the prema of Radha and Krishna.

তাঁর ভ্রাতুষ্পুত্র শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ঠাকুর ।
সকল সংসারে যশঃ ঘোষয়ে প্রচুর ॥ ৬৪৭ ॥

tāṁra bhrātuṣputra śrīraghunandana ṭhākura |
sakala saṃsāre yaśaḥ ghoṣaẏe pracura || 647 ||

tanra bhratushputra — his nephew; shri-raghunandana thakura — Sri Raghunandana Thakura; sakala samsare — throughout the world; yashah ghoshaye prachura — widely proclaimed

647His nephew, Sri Raghunandana Thakura,
is widely proclaimed throughout the world.

শ্রীমূর্তিকে লাড়ু খাওয়াইল যেই জন ।
তারে অল্পবুদ্ধি করে কোন মূঢ় জন ॥ ৬৪৮ ॥

śrīmūrtike lāṛu khāoẏāila yei jana |
tāre alpabuddhi kare kona mūṛha jana || 648 ||

shri-murtike — the Sri Murti; ladu khavaila — fed a laddu; yei jana — he who; tare alpabuddhi kare — would think him of little understanding; kona mudha jana — what foolish man

648He who fed the Sri Murti a sweet ball (laddu) —17
what fool would think him of little understanding?

সহজে বৈষ্ণব নহে বর্ণের ভিতর ।
কৃষ্ণসঙ্গে যার কথা সে কৃষ্ণ কেবল ॥ ৬৪৯ ॥

sahaje baiṣṇaba nahe barṇera bhitara |
kṛṣṇasaṅge yāra kathā se kṛṣṇa kebala || 649 ||

sahaje vaishnava — a Vaishnava by nature; nahe varnera bhitara — is not within varna; krishna-sange yara katha — whose converse is with Krishna; se krishna kevala — for him Krishna alone

649A Vaishnava by nature is beyond the bounds of varna;
he who converses with Krishna has Krishna alone.18

শ্রীমূর্তির সনে কথা যার অনুব্রত ।
তাঁহারে কেমনে জান কেমন মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৬৫০ ॥

śrīmūrtira sane kathā yāra anubrata |
tāṁhāre kemane jāna kemana mahattba || 650 ||

shri-murtira sane katha — converse with the Sri Murti; yara anuvrata — whose constant vow; tanhare kemane jana — how can you know him; kemana mahattva — what greatness

650He whose constant vow is converse with the Sri Murti —
how can you know what he is, what his greatness is?

যাহারে চৈতন্য বৈল মোর প্রাণ তুমি ।
প্রকাশ করিলা যারে অভিরাম গোস্বামী ॥ ৬৫১ ॥

yāhāre caitanya baila mora prāṇa tumi |
prakāśa karilā yāre abhirāma gosbāmī || 651 ||

yahare chaitanya baila — to whom Chaitanya said; mora prana tumi — you are My life; prakasha karila yare — whom revealed; abhirama gosvami — Abhirama Gosvami

651He to whom Chaitanya said, "You are My life",
whom Abhirama Gosvami revealed,

মদন বলিয়া অবতার জানাইল ।
চৈতন্যের কোলে সভে তেমনি দেখিল ॥ ৬৫২ ॥

madana baliẏā abatāra jānāila |
caitanyera kole sabhe temani dekhila || 652 ||

madana baliya — as Madana; avatara janaila — made known [his] avatara; chaitanyera kole — on Chaitanya's lap; sabhe temani dekhila — all saw him so

652making known that he was the avatara of Madana —
and all saw him so on Chaitanya's lap.19

কৃষ্ণের আবেশে নৃত্য জগমন মোহে ।
নাহি ভিন্নাভিন্ন সভে সমান সিনেহে ॥ ৬৫৩ ॥

kṛṣṇera ābeśe nṛtya jagamana mohe |
nāhi bhinnābhinna sabhe samāna sinehe || 653 ||

krishnera aveshe nritya — dancing rapt in Krishna; jaga-mana mohe — enchants the world's heart; nahi bhinnabhinna — no "mine" and "another's"; sabhe samana sinehe — equal love for all

653When he dances absorbed in Krishna he enchants the world's heart;
he has no "mine" and "another's" — the same love for all.

সর্বদা মধুর বাণী বোলয়ে বদনে ।
সর্বকাল না শুনিল উৎকট কথনে ॥ ৬৫৪ ॥

sarbadā madhura bāṇī bolaẏe badane |
sarbakāla nā śunila utkaṭa kathane || 654 ||

sarvada madhura vani — always sweet words; bolaye vadane — his lips speak; sarvakala na shunila — never was heard; utkata kathane — harsh speech

654Always sweet words come from his lips;
no one ever heard a harsh word from him.

চাতুরী মাধুরী লীলা বিলাস লাবণ্য ।
রসময় দেহ তার এ সংসারে ধন্য ॥ ৬৫৫ ॥

cāturī mādhurī līlā bilāsa lābaṇya |
rasamaẏa deha tāra e saṃsāre dhanya || 655 ||

chaturi madhuri — skill, sweetness; lila vilasa lavanya — lila, play, loveliness; rasamaya deha tara — his body full of rasa; e samsare dhanya — is blessed in this world

655Skill, sweetness, lila, play, loveliness —
his body, full of rasa, is blessed in this world.

পিতা যাঁর মহামতি শ্রীমুকুন্দদাস ।
চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে নির্মল বিশ্বাস ॥ ৬৫৬ ॥

pitā yāṁra mahāmati śrīmukundadāsa |
caitanya-sammata-pathe nirmala biśbāsa || 656 ||

pita yanra — whose father; mahamati shri-mukundadasa — the wise Sri Mukunda Dasa; chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; nirmala vishvasa — pure faith

656His father is the wise Sri Mukunda Dasa,
pure in faith on the path approved by Chaitanya.

ময়ূরের পাখা দেখি রাজ-সন্নিধানে ।
পড়িলেন কৃষ্ণরূপ আকর্ষিয়া মনে ॥ ৬৫৭ ॥

maẏūrera pākhā dekhi rāja-sannidhāne |
paṛilena kṛṣṇarūpa ākarṣiẏā mane || 657 ||

mayurera pakha dekhi — seeing a peacock feather; raja-sannidhane — in the king's presence; padilena — he fell [senseless]; krishna-rupa akarshiya mane — the form of Krishna drawing his mind

657Seeing a peacock feather in the king's presence,
he fell senseless, the form of Krishna drawing his mind.20

কে জানে কেমন রস চৈতন্যের সঙ্গী ।
জানয়ে অনন্ত-আদি যাঁরা অঙ্গ-সঙ্গী ॥ ৬৫৮ ॥

ke jāne kemana rasa caitanyera saṅgī |
jānaẏe ananta-ādi yāṁrā aṅga-saṅgī || 658 ||

ke jane — who knows; kemana rasa — what the rasa is; chaitanyera sangi — of Chaitanya's companions; janaye ananta-adi — Ananta and the others know; yanra anga-sangi — His limbs and companions

658Who knows what the rasa of Chaitanya's companions is?
Ananta and the others know it — His limbs and companions.

জীবে কি দেখিতে পায় কৃষ্ণের বৈভব ।
সেই জন দেখে যাতে কৃষ্ণ-অনুভব ॥ ৬৫৯ ॥

jībe ki dekhite pāẏa kṛṣṇera baibhaba |
sei jana dekhe yāte kṛṣṇa-anubhaba || 659 ||

jive ki dekhite paya — can a being see; krishnera vaibhava — Krishna's glory; sei jana dekhe — he sees; yate krishna-anubhava — in whom is realization of Krishna

659Can [an ordinary] being see the glory of Krishna?
He alone sees in whom there is realization of Krishna.

কি কহিব আর অস্ত্র-পারিষদ যত ।
পৃথিবী আইলা সভে নাম নিব কত ॥ ৬৬০ ॥

ki kahiba āra astra-pāriṣada yata |
pṛthibī āilā sabhe nāma niba kata || 660 ||

ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; astra-parishada yata — all the warriors and associates; prithivi aila sabhe — all came to earth; nama niba kata — how many shall I name

660What more shall I say? All His warriors and associates
came to earth — how many shall I name?

সমুদ্রের জল যবে কলসে পরিমাণি ।
পৃথিবীর রেণু যবে একে একে গণি ॥ ৬৬১ ॥

samudrera jala yabe kalase parimāṇi |
pṛthibīra reṇu yabe eke eke gaṇi || 661 ||

samudrera jala — the water of the ocean; yabe kalase parimani — if I measure with a pitcher; prithivira renu — the dust of the earth; yabe eke eke gani — if I count grain by grain

661If I could measure the water of the ocean with a pitcher,
if I could count the dust of the earth grain by grain,

আকাশের তারা যবে গণিবারে পারি ।
তভু গোরা-অবতার লেখিবারে নারি ॥ ৬৬২ ॥

ākāśera tārā yabe gaṇibāre pāri |
tabhu gorā-abatāra lekhibāre nāri || 662 ||

akashera tara — the stars of the sky; yabe ganibare pari — if I can count; tabhu gora-avatara — still the avatara of Gora; lekhibare nari — I cannot describe

662if I could count the stars of the sky —
still I could not describe the avatara of Gora.

মুঞি অতি অল্পবুদ্ধি কি কহিব আর ।
মূরুখ হইয়া করোঁ বেদের বিচার ॥ ৬৬৩ ॥

muñi ati alpabuddhi ki kahiba āra |
mūrukha haiẏā karoṁ bedera bicāra || 663 ||

munji ati alpabuddhi — I am very small of mind; ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; murukha haiya — being a fool; karon vedera vichara — I reason on the Vedas

663I am very small of mind — what more shall I say?
A fool, I venture to reason on the Vedas.

অন্ধ যেন দৃষ্টিহীন দিব্য রত্ন চাহে ।
খর্ব যেন চাঁদ ধরিবারে মেলে বাহে ॥ ৬৬৪ ॥

andha yena dṛṣṭihīna dibya ratna cāhe |
kharba yena cāṁda dharibāre mele bāhe || 664 ||

andha yena drishtihina — as a blind man without sight; divya ratna chahe — wants a divine jewel; kharva yena — as a dwarf; chanda dharibare mele bahe — stretches his arms to catch the moon

664As a blind man without sight wants to see a divine jewel,
as a dwarf stretches out his arms to catch the moon,

পঙ্গু মহী লঙ্ঘিবারে করে অহঙ্কার ।
ক্ষুদ্র পিপীলিকা গিরি চাহে বহিবার ॥ ৬৬৫ ॥

paṅgu mahī laṅghibāre kare ahaṅkāra |
kṣudra pipīlikā giri cāhe bahibāra || 665 ||

pangu — a lame man; mahi langhibare — to stride across the earth; kare ahankara — boasts; kshudra pipilika — a tiny ant; giri chahe vahibara — wants to carry a mountain

665as a lame man boasts that he will stride across the earth,
as a tiny ant wants to carry a mountain —

এছন হৃদয়ে আশ বিলাস আমার ।
গোরা-অবতার-কথন করিতে প্রচার ॥ ৬৬৬ ॥

echana hṛdaẏe āśa bilāsa āmāra |
gorā-abatāra-kathana karite pracāra || 666 ||

aichhana hridaye — thus in my heart; asha vilasa amara — my desire has arisen; gora-avatara-kathana — the tale of the avatara of Gora; karite prachara — to proclaim

666such a desire has arisen in my heart:
to proclaim the tale of the avatara of Gora.

করজোড় করি বোলোঁ শুন সর্বজন ।
বাচাল করয়ে গোরা এ মূকজন ॥ ৬৬৭ ॥

karajoṛa kari boloṁ śuna sarbajana |
bācāla karaẏe gorā e mūkajana || 667 ||

karajoda kari — with joined palms; bolon shuna sarvajana — I say: listen, all; vachala karaye gora — Gora makes eloquent; e muka-jana — this mute one

667With joined palms I say: listen, all!
Gora makes this mute one eloquent.

নির্জিহ্ব কহয়ে সে প্রকট চাটুবাণী ।
না পঢ়ি মূরুখ কহে ব্রহ্মের কাহিনী ॥ ৬৬৮ ॥

nirjihba kahaẏe se prakaṭa cāṭubāṇī |
nā paṛhi mūrukha kahe brahmera kāhinī || 668 ||

nirjihva — the tongueless; kahaye se prakata chatu-vani — speaks clear, sweet words; na padhi murukha — the unlettered fool; kahe brahmera kahini — tells the tale of Brahman

668The tongueless speaks clear and sweet words,
the unlettered fool tells the tale of Brahman.

পৃথিবী জনমি মহা মহা ভাগবত ।
কৃষ্ণের গোপত কথা করয়ে বেকত ॥ ৬৬৯ ॥

pṛthibī janami mahā mahā bhāgabata |
kṛṣṇera gopata kathā karaẏe bekata || 669 ||

prithivi janami — born on earth; maha maha bhagavata — great, great devotees; krishnera gopata katha — Krishna's secret words; karaye bekata — make manifest

669Great, great devotees, born on earth,
make manifest the secret words of Krishna.

অকারণে করুণা করয়ে সর্বজীবে ।
মাতা যেন দুরন্ত তনয় পরিষেবে ॥ ৬৭০ ॥

akāraṇe karuṇā karaẏe sarbajībe |
mātā yena duranta tanaẏa pariṣebe || 670 ||

akarane — without cause; karuna karaye sarvajive — are merciful to all beings; mata yena — as a mother; duranta tanaya parisheve — nurses a wayward son

670Without cause they are merciful to all beings,
as a mother nurses a wayward son.

এছন প্রভুর দয়া দেখিয়া অগাধ ।
অধম হইয়া অমৃতের করোঁ সাধ ॥ ৬৭১ ॥

echana prabhura daẏā dekhiẏā agādha |
adhama haiẏā amṛtera karoṁ sādha || 671 ||

aichhana prabhura daya — such mercy of the Lord; dekhiya agadha — seeing boundless; adhama haiya — though low; amritera karon sadha — I long for nectar

671Seeing such boundless mercy of the Lord,
I, though low, long for nectar.

শ্রীনরহরিদাসের দয়াময় দেহে ।
পাতকী দেখিয়া দয়া অবাধ সিনেহে ॥ ৬৭২ ॥

śrīnaraharidāsera daẏāmaẏa dehe |
pātakī dekhiẏā daẏā abādha sinehe || 672 ||

shri-naraharidasera — of Sri Narahari Dasa; dayamaya dehe — whose body is mercy; pataki dekhiya — seeing a sinner; daya avadha sinehe — boundless mercy and love

672Sri Narahari Dasa, whose body is mercy itself,
seeing a sinner, has boundless mercy and love.

দুরন্ত পাতকী অন্ধ অতি দুরাচারে ।
অনাথ দেখিয়া দয়া করিল আমারে ॥ ৬৭৩ ॥

duranta pātakī andha ati durācāre |
anātha dekhiẏā daẏā karila āmāre || 673 ||

duranta pataki — an incorrigible sinner; andha ati durachare — blind, of evil conduct; anatha dekhiya — seeing helpless; daya karila amare — showed mercy to me

673Me, an incorrigible sinner, blind, of evil conduct,
seeing me helpless, he showed mercy.

তাঁর দয়াবলে আর বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে ।
এই ভরসায় পুথি হইবে অবাধে ॥ ৬৭৪ ॥

tāṁra daẏābale āra baiṣṇaba-prasāde |
ei bharasāẏa puthi haibe abādhe || 674 ||

tanra daya-bale — by the power of his mercy; ara vaishnava-prasade — and by the grace of the Vaishnavas; ei bharasaya — trusting in this; puthi haibe avadhe — the book will be done without hindrance

674By the power of his mercy and by the grace of the Vaishnavas —
in this I trust — the book will be completed without hindrance.

করজোড় করি বোলে কাতর-বয়ানে ।
আত্ম নিবেদিয়ে মুঞি বৈষ্ণবচরণে ॥ ৬৭৫ ॥

karajoṛa kari bole kātara-baẏāne |
ātma nibediẏe muñi baiṣṇabacaraṇe || 675 ||

karajoda kari — with joined palms; bole katara-bayane — says in a humble voice; atma nivediye munji — I give myself; vaishnava-charane — to the feet of the Vaishnavas

675With joined palms I say in a humble voice:
I give myself to the feet of the Vaishnavas.

মোর অধিক অধম নাহিক মহী-মাঝে ।
বৈষ্ণবের কৃপাবলে সিদ্ধি হউক কাজে ॥ ৬৭৬ ॥

mora adhika adhama nāhika mahī-mājhe |
baiṣṇabera kṛpābale siddhi hauka kāje || 676 ||

mora adhika adhama — lower than I; nahika mahi-majhe — there is none on earth; vaishnavera kripa-bale — by the power of the Vaishnavas' mercy; siddhi hauka kaje — may the work succeed

676There is no one on earth lower than I;
by the power of the Vaishnavas' mercy may the work succeed.

দশনে ধরিয়া তৃণ এ লোচনদাস ।
প্রণতি মিনতি করে পূর মোর আশ ॥ ৬৭৭ ॥

daśane dhariẏā tṛṇa e locanadāsa |
praṇati minati kare pūra mora āśa || 677 ||

dashane dhariya trina — holding a straw between the teeth; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa; pranati minati kare — bows and entreats; pura mora asha — fulfil my hope

677Holding a straw between his teeth, this Lochana Dasa
bows and entreats: fulfil my hope!

সূত্রখণ্ড সায় পুথি শুন সর্বজন ।
অবতার আদিখণ্ডে কহিব এখন ॥ ৬৭৮ ॥

sūtrakhaṇḍa sāẏa puthi śuna sarbajana |
abatāra ādikhaṇḍe kahiba ekhana || 678 ||

sutrakhanda saya puthi — the book of the Sutra-khanda is ended; shuna sarvajana — listen, all; avatara — of the descent; adikhande kahiba ekhana — now I shall tell in the Adi-khanda

678The book of the Sutra-khanda is ended — listen, all:
now in the Adi-khanda I shall tell of the descent.

সূত্রকথা সায় এবে প্রেমের বিলাস ।
আনন্দ হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৭৯ ॥

sūtrakathā sāẏa ebe premera bilāsa |
ānanda hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 679 ||

sutra-katha saya — the telling of the "sutra" is ended; ebe premera vilasa — now the pastimes of prema; ananda hridaye — with joy in heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

679The telling of the "sutra" is ended; now come the pastimes of prema —
with joy in his heart says this Lochana Dasa.

Thus ends the Sutra-khanda of the Sri Chaitanya-mangala composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.

✦

Notes

  1. Narada, the Lord's eternal associate, speaks thus out of humility, as a devotee who longs for service.
  2. In the 1983 edition line 1 reads: "Go, Narada: in Shvetadvipa I abide." Balarama is the Lord's second body; according to Gaudiya teaching, from Him (as Sankarshana) come Ananta-Shesha, and Shiva with the Rudras (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5).
  3. Cf. Bhagavad-gita 4.8.
  4. The line is damaged in A ("ধরিয়া ব্রণী-কোডি"); after the 1983 edition, "leaning on the earth".
  5. Probably the three abodes of the Purusha-avataras — Karanodakashayi, Garbhodakashayi and Kshirodakashayi Vishnu — who, according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 5), are expansions of Sankarshana-Balarama.
  6. "Mountain of nectar" after the 1903 edition ("অমৃত-পর্বত"); in A and the 1983 edition the first word is corrupt.
  7. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4.55 ff.): Krishna appears as Gaura, taking the bhava and lustre of Radha, to taste Her love.
  8. Lochana Dasa calls Advaita an avatara of Mahesha (Shiva). According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 6.4–27) Advaita is Maha-Vishnu and also Sada-Shiva; Bhaktisiddhanta in the summary of this section says: "Shiva [appears] as Advaita Prabhu."
  9. The line admits two readings: parakrita (Sanskrit "rejected, set aside") — tamo-guna is set aside in him; or prakrita ("worldly") — the worldly tamo-guna [appears only] among his outward qualities. The thought is the same in either case: Shiva (and Advaita) is not under the sway of tamas; cf. Bhag. 12.13.16: "Shambhu is the best of Vaishnavas."
  10. Nityananda's father is usually called Hadai Pandita (Hadai Ojha), and His mother Padmavati. The name "Paramananda" is Lochana Dasa's.
  11. The 1983 edition has "with renunciation in His heart — Nityananda of wondrous deeds". The name "Kuvera Pandita" is found only in Lochana Dasa.
  12. Probably Gopinatha Acharya, Sarvabhauma's brother-in-law, and Kashi Mishra, in whose house the Lord lived at Puri; the line can also be read as one person: "Kashi Mishra Thakura, named Gopinatha".
  13. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 11) and the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika: the twelve gopalas are cowherd boys of Vraja who appeared as associates of Nityananda (among them Abhirama, Sundarananda, Gauridasa Pandita, Kala Krishnadasa, Purushottama, Kamalakara, Uddharana Datta, Parameshvara Dasa and others).
  14. The sense is unclear: perhaps Damodara Pandita and his brothers (so in A and in the 1983 edition).
  15. In A the beginning of the line is corrupt ("ক্ষণে…"); in the 1983 edition stanzas 640–644 are in a different order and lack the second line of v. 641.
  16. So also the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika (177): Narahari Sarakara is Madhumati, a companion of Radha in Vraja.
  17. A well-known tradition: the boy Raghunandana, entrusted by his father with the worship, persuaded the Deity of Gopinatha at Shrikhanda to eat a laddu, and the Deity ate it.
  18. The line also admits the reading "he is Krishna himself"; we follow the understanding consistent with Gaudiya teaching: the devotee does not become Krishna, but for him there is Krishna alone.
  19. Abhirama Thakura (Ramadasa), one of the twelve gopalas, is said to have recognized the Lord's eternal associates in people. "Madana" is Kamadeva; according to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika Raghunandana is Pradyumna (Kandarpa) of Dvaraka.
  20. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 15.121–125): Mukunda Dasa, a court physician, on seeing a fan of peacock feathers above the king's head, remembered Krishna and fell senseless.
